title: North London Forever
english_paragraphs: I’ve always had this weird connection to Arsenal. It started long before I signed. I don’t even really know how to explain it, except with one little story.
I’ve never been that much into video games. I am of that generation that always played outside, but the one exception was FIFA. I mostly played Career Mode. You know, where you get to be the manager?
The club I always chose to manage was Arsenal. They were my FIFA team.

Growing up in Norway, I watched a lot of Premier League and I just had this good feeling about Arsenal. I’d seen clips of Thierry Henry and the Invincibles. I knew the club had a history of developing playmakers like Fabregas, Nasri, Özil — really smart, technical players, who were good on the ball and played the difficult passes. My kind of players.

As I got older, around the 2015 edition, I started actually appearing in FIFA. I didn’t look much like me at first. I think I was like a 67 overall, but I was actually in the game and it was a big deal. So, naturally, one of the first things I did when I was pretending to be Arsène Wenger on Career Mode was to buy myself. Haha!
Me and Arsenal. It just seemed like a good match in my head.

That special connection turned into a reality when I signed here two years ago. It was a decision that changed my life around. I come into training smiling every day. But my story is definitely not Career Mode. This has been a very different journey to how I imagined it on FIFA. In real life, you can’t just select where you want to go and everything will be perfect.

People always want to know what it was like for me growing up as a teenager in Norway with all that crazy hype. And, to be honest, I don’t know how to answer that. It’s strange to say but, at the time, it felt… normal.
I think I was too young — maybe a little too naive? — to fully understand, you know?

I think people imagine that I had to avoid everything they were saying about me in the press and live in a bubble, but I didn’t. I actually used to read everything they wrote about me. I would literally sit down and read the newspapers. But I read them like, O.K., cool. That’s nice. And that was it. I moved on.

I had a good family around me, good friends, a good life. I was just a kid who loved football. Proper, proper loved it. I was obsessed. There was an artificial pitch right next to my house in Drammen — literally 100 metres away — and I lived there for my entire childhood. Sometimes when I go back home now, I see kids on that same pitch just chatting, taking shots casually and I’m like, what are you doing?! That’s not how my friends and I played. We were out there playing tournaments, one-on-ones until it got dark. This was serious.

I was also lucky that I had my dad, Hans Erik. He was my club coach at my childhood club Drammen Strong and then at Strømsgodset until I was 13 and my personal coach from when I was a baby. He’d played in the top division in Norway as a midfielder, so if I wasn’t playing with my friends, I was training with him. Really training.

Maybe you think you know the story? Pushy dad making his son practice every day. But actually it was the opposite. I was the one pushing him. He knew things the other parents didn't. So I wanted him to teach me, to give me an edge.

He was particularly obsessed with me developing my awareness and quick feet. He was always getting me to look over my shoulder before receiving the ball. In winter, when we couldn’t play outside, he took me to the indoor sports hall and we would do drills where he’d play the ball off a bench and it would bounce back to me. He would come up behind, pressing me from one side and I had to look and adjust before receiving it.
These days, when you see me turn away from a defender, using that touch and quick reading of the game, that’s the sports hall. That’s my dad.
I was so focused on being the best at that time. I knew I was talented but I wasn’t getting ahead of myself. I was just enjoying playing with my friends for my hometown club.
Then things started progressing really fast.
When I was 13, I made my debut for Strømsgodset.
When I was 15, I became the youngest player to play for the Norway national team.
That’s when things really went crazy.

I remember coming on for the last 20 minutes of a Euro 2016 qualifier against Bulgaria at the Ullevaal Stadion in Oslo and the whole stadium, more than 20,000 people, going mad. Every time I touched the ball, they cheered. I can still hear that sound.

The thing is, in Norway, we hadn’t had a “superstar” in such a long time that the fans were a little desperate and when they started hearing this talk about this young guy from Drammen, they just wanted to believe it, even if they didn't actually know if I was any good. It added to this strange hype.
And then the hype just builds more hype, and suddenly you’re linked with Real Madrid.
My dad handled everything with the clubs, and there were a lot. We went to Bayern, Dortmund, Man Utd, Liverpool, Madrid, Arsenal too. We got flown around in private planes and made to feel special.

I’m not just saying this… I was actually close to choosing Arsenal. When we went there, I got to train at London Colney. I met Arsène Wenger. He took me and Dad out for dinner. That was cool, but strange too. It’s Arsène Wenger, you know? He’s this legend I grew up watching on TV, and now I’m sitting across from him eating steak. I was so nervous I was just sitting there thinking, Is he analysing me right now? Is he going to judge me if I eat the fries? Maybe I should just leave them. Hahaha!

So, why Real Madrid then? I talked about it a lot with my dad and the rest of my family. In the end, Madrid is Madrid. They were the Champions League holders with the best players in the world. Back then, I loved Isco — he was so smooth on the ball. Another one of my kind of players! But the really key thing about Madrid’s offer was that they had a B team where I could play competitive football immediately. And the manager of that team? Zinedine Zidane. It felt like the total package.

Before we officially told them, I remember sitting with my dad on the sofa watching a Real Madrid game on TV. At one point, he turned to me with his phone in his hand like, “Is it time? Should we tell them?”
We’d been speaking about the decision for so long, as it was so hard to turn down all these other amazing clubs. But then we did it.
He’d had the draft saved in his phone for like a week or two already. This really simple message.
It was something like: “Martin has decided he wants to come, if you still want him.”
I just told him, “Send it.”
Let’s talk about my presentation day.
I’m actually cringing thinking about it now… but I know a lot of people talked about this at the time. I was basically a meme. So let me clear up what happened.

They sent a plane to pick us up from Norway in the morning. Really early. So, I wake up but I’m still half asleep. My hair is all over the place. I didn’t have time to shower. I just put on whatever clothes I could grab quickly, throw something smarter into a bag and we take the flight. I figure that once I arrive at the hotel in Madrid I can get changed, take a shower, prepare myself, you know?
But then we land, we get off the plane and I realise they are taking us directly to the training ground to do the medical and then the press conference. No hotel stop.
And I’m like, Wait, we’re doing this now?
Suddenly, I’m sitting next to Madrid legend Emilio Butragueño — who’s wearing a really smart suit, of course — and they are introducing me to the world.
I know you’ve seen the pictures.
Me, in this old stripey jumper, not even showered, trying to flatten my hair with my hands.

This was the biggest day of my life, images going all over the world. I’m supposed to be this player that Real Madrid has beaten everyone to sign and I look like a random school kid they just pulled from the stadium tour.
Butragueño is introducing me and in my head I’m like:
God, I wish I’d changed my jumper.
Someone could’ve told me.
Why didn’t anyone tell me???? Hahaha!

The other thing I’m thinking about at that moment, sitting there in front of all these people, is my Confirmation. If you don’t know, it’s a common ceremony for kids in Norway to go through where you celebrate becoming an adult. I did mine when I was 15. It’s just for family and close friends and it’s normal that at the end of the event, the kid gets up to do a short speech to thank everyone for coming. Except at mine, I froze. I was too shy to speak in front of my family — the people I’m most comfortable with! I was confident on the football pitch, but speaking in front of people? No way.
One year later, I’m front and centre at a Real Madrid press conference. In this stripey jumper.
Haha can you imagine??
I was so out of my comfort zone. You can see the fear in my face.
When it’s my turn to speak, I have these big headphones on and I’m practically whispering in Norwegian like, “Uh yeah… It’s a great pleasure. Ummm, I’m very proud.…”

But in a weird way, I think that moment actually helped a lot of people’s perceptions of me. As soon as you get famous, people expect you to be a certain way. Like you’re this superhero, who can do anything. You can play football, so you also must be able to speak well, be confident, give everything of yourself at all times. But that’s not realistic.

I think that press conference helped people connect to what I was going through. I was just this shy little kid. I mean, have you met a 16-year-old recently? They felt for me and saw how normal I was.

A few days after the presentation, I went into training for the first time and, honestly, that was just surreal. I’m not old enough to drive, so my dad actually has to bring me in to play with Isco and Ronaldo and Ramos and Modric and Bale and Benzema, like he’s dropping me off at school.

All I’m thinking is about how these guys will treat me when I walk into their dressing room. This little kid who didn’t speak any Spanish. But they were all very kind, and the ones who spoke English — Kroos, Modric, Ronaldo — took extra care of me in the beginning. They gave me advice and helped me a lot. But honestly I don’t think any of them were particularly worried about a 16-year-old from Norway taking their place in the team.

We made this plan with the club that I would train every day with the first team but get regular game time with the B team. It seemed like a smart plan at the time, but it worked out that I ended up not finding my place with either group.

With the B team, I wasn’t with them regularly so I didn’t find that connection. In the first team, I was just some kid who came to train. I wasn’t involved in matches. I felt a bit like an outsider. I was stuck in between.

I stopped playing with the spark that was typical of my game. I went a bit too safe for a time. I was worrying more about not making mistakes than actually playing my game. And my game was always about making a difference. Playing the difficult pass. I can understand why it happened now. I was still a little kid, but I’ve learned that you have to be ruthless. You have to not give a f***. You have to show the real you on the pitch.
After a couple of years, I just wasn’t progressing.

The press came after me for not immediately living up to the hype. I was an easy target. If you really know me, you know I smile a lot, but I think from the outside sometimes my face looks more grumpy than I actually am! It made it easier for them to write about how I was struggling to adapt.
I remember reading a headline like: “NOW IT’S MAKE OR BREAK TIME FOR MARTIN ØDEGAARD”
And I’m like, make or break? I’m 18 years old!

Maybe if I’d been Spanish, I might have been given a bit more time to grow. Honestly, I don’t know. In the end, it’s just the nature of the hype machine. There is no in-between in modern football. You’re either the best signing in history, or you’re sh**.

Listen, I want to make it clear that I am not complaining about my time at Real Madrid. Not at all. Going to Madrid was a good thing for me. I learned so much about what it takes to reach the top. I watched, trained and learned from the best players in the world, my idols. I played at the Bernabéu. I learned to be tough and to face challenges. It’s part of who I am now. It’s the reason I’m where I am today.

But when things got tough, I never lost sight of the bigger picture. In my head I was always like, How can I change? How can I get better? Because in the end, I will never be the guy who is happy to just train at the biggest club and maybe get a few minutes here and there. I was always thinking about what I needed to do to be the best version of me I could be. That’s why I needed to move on.
Back when I was coming up in Norway, it seemed like I had all the options in the world. Only a couple of years later, I had to come to terms with the fact that clubs weren’t lining up for me anymore.

If you’re playing Career Mode and you go from Real Madrid to Heerenveen, maybe you think something has gone wrong. No offence to the Dutch league! But honestly, for me, it was a fantastic experience. I got to play regularly at first-team level, which was exactly what I needed. I owe a lot to my loans at Heerenveen, where I grew as a person, and Vitesse, where I grew as a player.

At Heerenveen, I got my driving licence (I didn’t need my dad taking me to training anymore), I learned to be by myself and to take responsibility. Then at Vitesse, I met the manager Leonid Slutsky. He was amazing. He believed in my ability without asking me to be magical every time. He improved my decision making and teamwork. Soon I was finding the difficult passes again.

After two and a half seasons on loan in the Netherlands, I was ready to come back to La Liga and settle down at Real Sociedad for at least two seasons. In the end, it didn’t work out that way. It’s an amazing club in a beautiful part of the world, with fans that are so connected to their team. In a way, the Basque culture is more like Norway. People are more reserved on the outside but once they take you into their hearts, they are so caring and protective. You become one of their own. I loved that.
I was playing well and I was really happy there, but after a year when Madrid called I thought, I have to take this chance now. This is the dream I’ve been following since I was 16.
I had a good connection with Zidane from when he coached the B team and he took good care of me, so I wanted to believe it would work out this time.

But then I got COVID. I started the first two games of that season in 2020-21, but I wasn’t fully recovered. I didn’t perform at my best and after that, I didn’t get many more chances. Almost nothing. Meanwhile, I’m watching Real Sociedad on TV thinking, I could’ve still been there.
I was thinking about this a lot.
I spoke to my agent ahead of the January transfer window, “Look, we need to do something… I didn’t come back to just be there. I came back here to play. I need to play and keep improving.”

He tried to calm me down, telling me we’d just cancelled one contract to come back to Madrid. I’d always said I wanted stability and now five months later I wanted to move again? But I had made up my mind.
I can only thank Madrid for investing in a 16-year-old kid. Everybody had good intentions and I don’t blame anyone, but I needed to find a place where I could settle. I needed to find an actual home.
I found it in North London.
Career Mode.
This little memory in the back of my mind just flashed up the second my agent mentioned that Arsenal were interested. It just felt right.

I spoke to Mikel Arteta on a Zoom call and he told me all about the project. At the time, Arsenal were not doing well. They were way down like 15th in the table, but that meeting… Honestly, I challenge anyone to come away from a meeting with Arteta and not believe everything he tells you.
He is next level. It's hard to explain. He’s passionate, he’s intense and sometimes, yeah, he’s a bit crazy… but when he speaks, you understand that whatever he says will happen, will happen.

He told me his plan, everything he was building towards. He knew exactly what needed to change at the club. He told me all about these amazing young players in the squad — Saka, Martinelli, Smith Rowe, etc., etc. He told me how he wanted me to fit in and how I was going to improve.
I got this strong feeling that he was onto something really special.

Not that I needed any more convincing but I also got so many messages from Arsenal fans on Instagram telling me to sign. Not just me, my whole family, friends and everyone I follow! It’s such an amazing, active fan base. Random people I know would show me how the comments on their posts were full of stuff like “Tell Martin to sign for Arsenal.”
That was just… Wow.

I have to say, the fans have been amazing since I’ve been here. Maybe some people think that doesn't matter to us as players, but it matters. At the Emirates, every time you make a tackle to knock the ball out for a throw-in, the whole stadium cheers like you've scored a goal. They give you this confidence that you can do anything.

At the end of my first season here in 2020-21, when we finished eighth, it seemed like no one at the club lost faith in what we were doing. Everyone believed in us. It was all part of the plan. Even last season when things got really tough. Obviously, we took it hard losing out on Champions League qualification when it was in our hands like that, but we learned from that experience.
We came back closer, stronger, hungrier.

We’re in the title race now, but there’s a long way to go and, trust me, no one is thinking about May yet. It’s a cliché but we are taking it game by game, training session by training session. One piece at a time.
I will say this, though, if there’s anyone left who still doesn’t fully believe in this team, take it from me: there are no limits on what we can achieve. No one can tell me otherwise.
I’m so proud to be captain of this club and I feel like I’m going to be here a long time.

After the win over West Ham on Boxing Day, I got the chance to speak to Wenger — it was the first time he’d been back to the Emirates since 2018, and the first time I’d seen him since that steak and fries all those years ago. We had a good chat and he mentioned that he’d kept a close eye on my career even after I chose Madrid. He was honest and said that at one point he was actually worried about the way things were going for me, but now he’s so happy to see me doing well in the right environment.
He’d recognised something. Ever since I left Norway, it’s like everything has felt sort of temporary. I haven’t had that stability, that real deep connection, until now, and that’s so important.

Whenever I lead the team out at the Emirates, I have this moment to myself. I want to really feel that atmosphere, that electricity from the fans. I always listen as they play North London Forever over the speakers and I start singing along under my breath.
I get goosebumps every time.
I close my eyes, and I think about myself as a kid out on the artificial pitch in Drammen. If you’d have shown that kid a snapshot of this moment and told him this was in his future?
He would have died for this.
It’s been a hell of a long road, but I’m living my dream.
I’m home. And the best is yet to come.
chinese_paragraphs: 我和阿森纳之间一直有一种奇妙的缘分。它在我签约之前很久就开始了。除了用一个小故事来讲，我实在不知道该怎么解释。
我从来不算沉迷电子游戏。我们这一代人总是在外面野，唯一的例外是 FIFA。我基本只玩生涯模式。就是你可以当主教练的那个模式？
我一直选来执教的俱乐部，是阿森纳。那是我的 FIFA 主队。
在挪威长大，我看了很多英超，对阿森纳就是有一种莫名的好感。我看过蒂埃里·亨利和那支“不败之师”的集锦。我知道这家俱乐部有培养法布雷加斯、纳斯里、厄齐尔这类组织者的传统——都是那种聪明、有技术、球粘在脚上、敢传刁钻直塞的球员。正是我喜欢的类型。
等我大一些，大约在 FIFA 2015 那一代，我自己开始真的出现在游戏里了。一开始长得不太像我。我记得总评大概是 67，但我是真的进了游戏，这可是件大事。所以很自然，当我在生涯模式里扮演温格时，最先做的几件事之一，就是把我自己买进来。哈哈！
我和阿森纳。在我脑子里，这两者就是般配的。
两年前我签约到这里，这份奇妙的缘分变成了现实。这是一个改变了我人生的决定。我每天都是笑着走进训练基地的。但我的故事，肯定不是生涯模式。这一路走来，和在 FIFA 里想象的完全不同。现实生活里，你没法选好目的地，然后就一切完美。
人们总想知道，一个挪威少年顶着那么疯狂的热度长大，是什么滋味。说实话，我不知道该怎么回答。说来奇怪，在当时的我看来，那一切……很平常。
我想我那时太小了——也许是有点太天真？——还没法完全明白，你懂吗？
我以为大家会想象我不得不躲开媒体上关于我的一切言论，活在泡泡里，但我没有。我其实把媒体写的关于我的东西全读了。我真的会坐下来，一份一份读报纸。但我读起来的反应是：哦，挺好。不错嘛。然后就没有然后了。该干嘛干嘛。
我有很好的家人在身边，很好的朋友，很好的生活。我就是一个爱踢球的孩子。是真心的、发自己内心的爱。我痴迷于此。在德拉门我家旁边就有一块人工草皮球场——真的就一百米——我在那里度过了整个童年。现在有时回老家，我看见孩子们在那块球场上闲聊，随意颠两脚射门，我心想：你们在干嘛？！我和朋友们可不是这么踢的。我们在那儿打锦标赛、单挑单挑再单挑，一直到天黑。这是很认真的事。
我还有一个幸运之处：我有我爸爸，汉斯·埃里克。他是我童年俱乐部德拉门斯特朗的教练，后来直到我十三岁一直带斯特罗姆加德，而从我还在襁褓里时起，他就是我的私人教练。他当过挪威顶级联赛的中场，所以只要我没在跟朋友们踢球，我就在跟他训练。是很认真的那种训练。
也许你以为你知道这个故事？逼着儿子天天练球的虎爸。其实恰恰相反。是我追着他要练。他知道别的家长不知道的东西。所以我想让他教我，让我比别人多一点优势。
他特别执着于练我的观察意识和脚下频率。接球前回头的观察，是他一直逼着我养成的习惯。冬天没法在室外踢，他就带我去室内体育馆，做那种他把球往长凳上一踢、球反弹回来的练习。他会从背后上来，从一侧逼抢我，我必须先观察、再调整，然后才能接球。
如今你们看到我背身摆脱防守队员，用那种触球和对比赛的快速阅读——那就是那间体育馆。那就是我爸。
那时候我满脑子只想做到最好。我知道自己有天赋，但我没有飘飘然。我只是在享受和朋友们一起为家乡俱乐部踢球。
然后一切都开始加速。
十三岁，我完成了斯特罗姆加德的首秀。
十五岁，我成了代表挪威国家队出场的最年轻球员。
从那时起，一切真的疯狂起来。
我记得2016年欧洲杯预选赛对保加利亚，在奥斯陆的乌勒瓦尔球场，我第70分钟左右替补登场，全场两万多人瞬间疯狂。我每次触球，他们都在欢呼。那个声音我到现在都记得。
事情是这样的：挪威已经太久没有出过“超级巨星”了，球迷们有点饥渴；当他们开始听到关于这个德拉门小伙子的传闻，他们就是想相信，哪怕他们其实并不确定我到底行不行。这又给那股奇怪的热度添了一把火。
然后热度会生出更多热度，突然之间，你就和皇马联系在一起了。
和各家俱乐部的接洽都由我爸打理，找上门的非常多。我们去过拜仁、多特蒙德、曼联、利物浦、皇马，也有阿森纳。我们坐私人飞机飞来飞去，处处被当成贵客。
我不是在夸张……我当时真的很接近选阿森纳。我们去那里的时候，我在伦敦科尔尼训练基地训练过。我见到了温格。他还带我和我爸出去吃了顿饭。很酷，但也很奇怪。那可是温格啊，你懂吗？他是我在电视上看大的传奇，现在我却坐在他对面吃牛排。我紧张得要命，坐在那儿满脑子想的是：他是不是正在分析我？我要是吃了薯条，他会给我打低分吗？要不我还是别碰了。哈哈哈！
那么，为什么最后是皇马？我和我爸、和全家人反复讨论过。说到底，皇马就是皇马。他们是欧冠卫冕冠军，拥有世界上最强的球员。那时候我很喜欢伊斯科——他拿球那么丝滑。又是一个我喜欢的类型！但皇马这份报价里真正关键的东西，是他们的B队——我可以立刻踢上有竞争力的正式比赛。而那支球队的教练是谁？齐内丁·齐达内。感觉这就是一份完美套餐。
在正式答复之前，我记得我和我爸坐在沙发上，看皇马的比赛。看着看着，他忽然拿着手机转向我：“是时候了吗？咱们告诉他们吧？”
这个决定我们已经讨论了很久，因为拒绝那些同样出色的俱乐部实在太难。然后我们就发了。
那条信息在他手机里存了大概一两个星期。非常简单的一句话。
大意是：“马丁决定要来，如果你们还要他的话。”
我只跟他说：“发吧。”
来说说我的亮相日吧。
现在想起来我都会脚趾抠地……但我知道当时很多人都在议论这件事。我基本上成了一个表情包。那让我来还原一下当时发生了什么。
早上他们派了一架飞机来挪威接我们。非常早。我醒了，但还半睡半醒。头发炸得到处都是。来不及洗澡。我随手抓了几件衣服套上，往包里塞了件稍微体面的，就上了飞机。我心想，等到了马德里的酒店，我可以换衣服、洗个澡、收拾一下自己，对吧？
结果飞机落地，下了舷梯我才发现，他们要直接带我们去训练基地体检，然后开发布会。酒店？没有这一站。
我心想：等等，现在就来吗？
突然之间，我坐在皇马传奇布特拉格诺旁边——他当然穿着一身非常精神的西装——他们正在把我介绍给全世界。
我知道你们看过那些照片。
我，穿着那件旧条纹毛衣，澡都没洗，用手拼命压着头发。
那是我人生中最大的一天，照片传遍了全世界。我本该是那个皇马力压群雄签下的天才，看上去却像他们刚从球场参观团里随便拉来的中学生。
布特拉格诺在做介绍，我心里想的是：
天哪，真希望我换了件毛衣。
怎么没人提醒我一声。
为什么没有任何人告诉我？？？哈哈哈！
那一刻，坐在这么多人面前，我脑子里想的另一件事，是我的坚振礼。如果你不了解，这是挪威孩子都会经历的一种成人仪式。我十五岁时办的。只有家人和好友参加，按惯例仪式的最后，过礼的孩子要站起来做个简短致辞，感谢大家的到来。可轮到我的时候，我僵住了。在最让我放松的人——我的家人——面前，我居然紧张得说不出话！在球场上我信心十足，可要当众讲话？没门。
一年之后，我就坐在了皇马发布会的正中央。穿着那件条纹毛衣。
哈哈你能想象吗？？
我完全不在自己的舒适区。你能从我脸上看到恐惧。
轮到我发言时，我戴着巨大的同传耳机，用挪威语小声嘀咕：“呃，好的……我很荣幸。嗯……我非常骄傲……”
但说来奇怪，我觉得那个瞬间反而改变了很多人对我的看法。人一出名，别人就会期待你按某种方式活着。好像你是个无所不能的超级英雄。你会踢球，所以你也必须会讲话、必须自信、必须随时随地掏出全部的自己。可这不现实。
我觉得那场发布会让人们理解了我当时的处境。我只是一个害羞的小孩。这么说吧，你最近见过十六岁的孩子吗？他们心疼我，也看到了我有多普通。
亮相几天后，我第一次去一线队训练，说实话，那感觉超现实。我还没到开车的年纪，得由我爸送我去和伊斯科、C罗、拉莫斯、莫德里奇、贝尔、本泽马一起训练，就像送我上学一样。
我满脑子想的都是：走进他们的更衣室时，这些大人物会怎么对我。一个西班牙语都不会说的小屁孩。但他们都非常友善，会说英语的那几个——克罗斯、莫德里奇、C罗——一开始还格外照顾我。他们给我建议，帮了我很多。不过说实话，我想他们谁也没怎么担心过一个来自挪威的十六岁小孩会抢走他们的位置。
我们和俱乐部定了一个计划：我每天跟一线队训练，但定期跟B队打比赛。当时看着很聪明，结果却是我两边都没找到归属。
在B队，我不常在，融不进那个集体。在一线队，我只是个来训练的小孩。比赛没有我的份。我有点像个局外人。我卡在中间。
我踢球失去了那种标志性的火花。有段时间我踢得太过保守。我更怕犯错，而不是去做自己真正擅长的事。而我的足球，从来都是关于改变比赛的。传出那些刁钻的球。现在我理解这一切是怎么发生的了。那时我还是个小孩，但我后来懂得：你必须狠。你必须豁出去，谁的脸色都不看。你必须把真实的自己亮在球场上。
几年过去，我没有进步。
媒体开始围攻我，因为我没有立刻兑现那些吹捧。我是个好靶子。如果你真的了解我，你知道我其实很爱笑，但我猜从外面看，我的脸有时显得比实际更臭！这让他们写“我难以适应”更容易了。
我记得读过一个大标题：“马丁·厄德高，现在是成是败的关键时刻”
我心想：成或败？我才十八岁！
如果我是个西班牙球员，也许人们会多给我一些成长的时间。说实话，我不知道。说到底，这就是热度机器的天性。现代足球里没有中间地带。你要么是史上最佳签约，要么就是垃圾。
听着，我想说清楚：我不是在抱怨皇马时光。完全没有。去马德里对我来说是好事。关于登顶需要付出什么，我学到了太多。我观察着、训练着，向世界上最强的球员、我的偶像们学习。我在伯纳乌踢过球。我学会了坚强，学会了直面挑战。这已经是我的一部分。正因如此，我才有今天。
但当日子变得艰难时，我从未丢掉对大局的判断。我心里始终想的是：我怎么改变？我怎么变强？因为说到底，我永远不会做那种“在最大的俱乐部训练训练、偶尔捞几分钟上场就很满足”的人。我一直在想，要怎样做才能成为最好的自己。这就是我必须继续前进的原因。
当年在挪威蹿红的时候，我似乎手握全世界的选项。仅仅几年之后，我就不得不接受：俱乐部们已经不再排着队要我了。
如果你在生涯模式里从皇马转会去海伦芬，也许你会觉得哪里出问题了。没有冒犯荷甲的意思！但说实话，对我而言，那是一段绝佳的经历。我获得了一线队的稳定出场，这正是我需要的。我很感激在海伦芬和维特斯的租借——在海伦芬我作为一个人成长了，在维特斯我作为一名球员成长了。
在海伦芬，我考下了驾照（再也不用我爸送我去训练了），学会了独立生活、自己扛责任。然后到了维特斯，我遇到了主教练莱昂尼德·斯卢茨基。他非常出色。他相信我的能力，却从不要求我每次都变魔术。他提升了我的决策和团队配合。很快，我又开始传出那些刁钻的球了。
在荷兰租借的两个半赛季之后，我已经准备好回到西甲，在皇家社会安顿下来，至少踢两个赛季。最终，事情没有按那个剧本走。那是一家了不起的俱乐部，坐落在世界上一片美丽的角落，球迷和球队血肉相连。某种意义上，巴斯克文化更像挪威。人们外表比较内敛，可一旦你走进他们心里，他们无比体贴、无比护短。你会成为“他们自己人”。我爱极了这一点。
我踢得很好，在那里非常开心，但一年后皇马来电话时，我心想：这个机会我现在必须抓住。这是我从十六岁起就追随的梦想。
我和齐达内在他带B队时就关系很好，他一直很照顾我，所以我愿意相信这一次会成。
但我得了新冠。2020-21赛季的前两场我都是首发，但我没有完全恢复。我没能拿出最好的状态，之后机会就变得寥寥。几乎为零。与此同时，我在电视上看皇家社会的比赛，心想：我本来还可以留在那儿的。
这个问题我想了很久。
一月转会窗之前我跟经纪人说：“听着，我们得做点什么……我回来不是为了坐着的。我回来是为了上场。我需要比赛，需要持续进步。”
他想让我冷静，说我们刚毁约了一次才回的马德里。我一直说要稳定，结果五个月后又要走？但我已经拿定了主意。
对于皇马在一个十六岁孩子身上的投入，我只有感激。每个人都出于好意，我不怪任何人，但我需要找到一个能扎根的地方。我需要一个真正的家。
我在北伦敦找到了它。
生涯模式。
经纪人一提到阿森纳有意，我脑海深处的那段小记忆就闪了出来。就是觉得对了。
我和米克尔·阿尔特塔视频通话，他给我讲了整个计划。那时阿森纳处境不好。联赛排名掉到了第十五左右，但那次谈话……说实话，我敢向任何人挑战：跟阿尔特塔谈完，你不可能不信他说的一切。
他是另一个级别的。很难解释。他有激情、有强度，有时候，嗯，是有点疯……但当他开口，你会明白：他说会发生的事，就会发生。
他跟我讲了计划，讲了他正在打造的一切。他很清楚俱乐部哪里需要改变。他给我讲了队里那些出色的年轻人——萨卡、马丁内利、史密斯·罗，等等等等。他讲了想让我怎样融入，我会怎样进步。
我有一种强烈的预感：他正在成就一番真正特别的事业。
倒不需要更多说服，Instagram 上还有成千上万的阿森纳球迷给我发消息催我签约。不只是我，我全家人、朋友们、我关注的所有人都在收！这球迷群体真是又热情又活跃。我认识的一些普通人会给我看，他们帖子底下的评论全都是“让马丁签阿森纳”。
那感觉真是……哇。
我必须说，自从我来到这里，球迷一直太棒了。也许有人觉得这对我们球员不重要，但它重要。在酋长球场，哪怕你只是一次把球铲出边线的防守，全场都会像你进球一样欢呼。他们给你一种“你什么都能做到”的自信。
我在这里的第一个赛季，2020-21赛季末我们排第八，俱乐部里似乎没有人对我们正在做的事失去信心。所有人都相信我们。这都是计划的一部分。哪怕上赛季那么艰难的时候也一样。显然，眼看着欧冠资格攥在手里却最终错失，我们都很痛苦，但我们从那段经历里学到了东西。
我们以更团结、更强壮、更饥饿的姿态回归。
现在我们在争冠行列，但路还很长，相信我，还没有人开始想五月的事。话虽老套，我们就是一场一场地踢，一练一练地练。一块砖一块砖地砌。
不过我要说：如果还有人没有完全相信这支球队，听我一句——我们能达到的高度没有上限。谁说什么我都不能同意。
能担任这家俱乐部的队长，我无比自豪，而且我感觉自己会在这里待很久。
节礼日赢下西汉姆之后，我有机会和温格聊了聊——那是2018年以来他第一次回到酋长球场，也是自当年那顿牛排薯条之后，我第一次见他。我们聊得很愉快。他说即使在我选择皇马之后，他也一直关注着我的职业生涯。他很坦诚，说有一阵子他真的为我的处境担心过，但现在看到我在对的环境里过得很好，他非常高兴。
他看出了某种东西。离开挪威之后，一切都像是临时性的。我始终没有那种稳定感、那种真正深层的联结，直到现在——而这太重要了。
每当我在酋长球场率队出场，我都有一个属于自己的瞬间。我想真正去感受那种氛围，球迷带来的那种电流。当扬声器里响起 North London Forever，我总会跟着轻声哼唱。
每次都起鸡皮疙瘩。
我闭上眼睛，想起小时候那个在德拉门人工球场上的自己。如果你把此刻的画面拿给那个孩子看，告诉他这会是他未来的一部分？
为了这个，他什么都愿意。
这是一条长得要命的路，但我正活在自己的梦里。
我到家了。而最好的，还在后面。

sentence_pairs.en: I’ve always had this weird connection to Arsenal.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我和阿森纳之间一直有一种奇妙的缘分。

sentence_pairs.en: It started long before I signed.
sentence_pairs.cn: 它在我签约之前很久就开始了。

sentence_pairs.en: I don’t even really know how to explain it, except with one little story.
sentence_pairs.cn: 除了用一个小故事来讲，我实在不知道该怎么解释。

sentence_pairs.en: I’ve never been that much into video games.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我从来不算沉迷电子游戏。

sentence_pairs.en: I am of that generation that always played outside, but the one exception was FIFA.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我们这一代人总是在外面野，唯一的例外是 FIFA。

sentence_pairs.en: I mostly played Career Mode.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我基本只玩生涯模式。

sentence_pairs.en: You know, where you get to be the manager?
sentence_pairs.cn: 就是你可以当主教练的那个模式？

sentence_pairs.en: The club I always chose to manage was Arsenal.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我一直选来执教的俱乐部，是阿森纳。

sentence_pairs.en: They were my FIFA team.
sentence_pairs.cn: 那是我的 FIFA 主队。

sentence_pairs.en: Growing up in Norway, I watched a lot of Premier League and I just had this good feeling about Arsenal.
sentence_pairs.cn: 在挪威长大，我看了很多英超，对阿森纳就是有一种莫名的好感。

sentence_pairs.en: I’d seen clips of Thierry Henry and the Invincibles.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我看过蒂埃里·亨利和那支“不败之师”的集锦。

sentence_pairs.en: I knew the club had a history of developing playmakers like Fabregas, Nasri, Özil — really smart, technical players, who were good on the ball and played the difficult passes.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我知道这家俱乐部有培养法布雷加斯、纳斯里、厄齐尔这类组织者的传统——都是那种聪明、有技术、球粘在脚上、敢传刁钻直塞的球员。

sentence_pairs.en: My kind of players.
sentence_pairs.cn: 正是我喜欢的类型。

sentence_pairs.en: As I got older, around the 2015 edition, I started actually appearing in FIFA.
sentence_pairs.cn: 等我大一些，大约在 FIFA 2015 那一代，我自己开始真的出现在游戏里了。

sentence_pairs.en: I didn’t look much like me at first.
sentence_pairs.cn: 一开始长得不太像我。

sentence_pairs.en: I think I was like a 67 overall, but I was actually in the game and it was a big deal.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我记得总评大概是 67，但我是真的进了游戏，这可是件大事。

sentence_pairs.en: So, naturally, one of the first things I did when I was pretending to be Arsène Wenger on Career Mode was to buy myself.
sentence_pairs.cn: 所以很自然，当我在生涯模式里扮演温格时，最先做的几件事之一，就是把我自己买进来。

sentence_pairs.en: Haha!
sentence_pairs.cn: 哈哈！

sentence_pairs.en: Me and Arsenal.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我和阿森纳。

sentence_pairs.en: It just seemed like a good match in my head.
sentence_pairs.cn: 在我脑子里，这两者就是般配的。

sentence_pairs.en: That special connection turned into a reality when I signed here two years ago.
sentence_pairs.cn: 两年前我签约到这里，这份奇妙的缘分变成了现实。

sentence_pairs.en: It was a decision that changed my life around.
sentence_pairs.cn: 这是一个改变了我人生的决定。

sentence_pairs.en: I come into training smiling every day.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我每天都是笑着走进训练基地的。

sentence_pairs.en: But my story is definitely not Career Mode.
sentence_pairs.cn: 但我的故事，肯定不是生涯模式。

sentence_pairs.en: This has been a very different journey to how I imagined it on FIFA.
sentence_pairs.cn: 这一路走来，和在 FIFA 里想象的完全不同。

sentence_pairs.en: In real life, you can’t just select where you want to go and everything will be perfect.
sentence_pairs.cn: 现实生活里，你没法选好目的地，然后就一切完美。

sentence_pairs.en: People always want to know what it was like for me growing up as a teenager in Norway with all that crazy hype.
sentence_pairs.cn: 人们总想知道，一个挪威少年顶着那么疯狂的热度长大，是什么滋味。

sentence_pairs.en: And, to be honest, I don’t know how to answer that.
sentence_pairs.cn: 说实话，我不知道该怎么回答。

sentence_pairs.en: It’s strange to say but, at the time, it felt…
sentence_pairs.cn: 说来奇怪，在当时的我看来，那一切……

sentence_pairs.en: normal.
sentence_pairs.cn: 很平常。

sentence_pairs.en: I think I was too young — maybe a little too naive?
sentence_pairs.cn: 我想我那时太小了——也许是有点太天真？

sentence_pairs.en: — to fully understand, you know?
sentence_pairs.cn: ——还没法完全明白，你懂吗？

sentence_pairs.en: I think people imagine that I had to avoid everything they were saying about me in the press and live in a bubble, but I didn’t.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我以为大家会想象我不得不躲开媒体上关于我的一切言论，活在泡泡里，但我没有。

sentence_pairs.en: I actually used to read everything they wrote about me.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我其实把媒体写的关于我的东西全读了。

sentence_pairs.en: I would literally sit down and read the newspapers.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我真的会坐下来，一份一份读报纸。

sentence_pairs.en: But I read them like, O.K., cool.
sentence_pairs.cn: 但我读起来的反应是：哦，挺好。

sentence_pairs.en: That’s nice.
sentence_pairs.cn: 不错嘛。

sentence_pairs.en: And that was it.
sentence_pairs.cn: 然后就没有然后了。

sentence_pairs.en: I moved on.
sentence_pairs.cn: 该干嘛干嘛。

sentence_pairs.en: I had a good family around me, good friends, a good life.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我有很好的家人在身边，很好的朋友，很好的生活。

sentence_pairs.en: I was just a kid who loved football.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我就是一个爱踢球的孩子。

sentence_pairs.en: Proper, proper loved it.
sentence_pairs.cn: 是真心的、发自己内心的爱。

sentence_pairs.en: I was obsessed.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我痴迷于此。

sentence_pairs.en: There was an artificial pitch right next to my house in Drammen — literally 100 metres away — and I lived there for my entire childhood.
sentence_pairs.cn: 在德拉门我家旁边就有一块人工草皮球场——真的就一百米——我在那里度过了整个童年。

sentence_pairs.en: Sometimes when I go back home now, I see kids on that same pitch just chatting, taking shots casually and I’m like, what are you doing?!
sentence_pairs.cn: 现在有时回老家，我看见孩子们在那块球场上闲聊，随意颠两脚射门，我心想：你们在干嘛？！

sentence_pairs.en: That’s not how my friends and I played.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我和朋友们可不是这么踢的。

sentence_pairs.en: We were out there playing tournaments, one-on-ones until it got dark.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我们在那儿打锦标赛、单挑单挑再单挑，一直到天黑。

sentence_pairs.en: This was serious.
sentence_pairs.cn: 这是很认真的事。

sentence_pairs.en: I was also lucky that I had my dad, Hans Erik.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我还有一个幸运之处：我有我爸爸，汉斯·埃里克。

sentence_pairs.en: He was my club coach at my childhood club Drammen Strong and then at Strømsgodset until I was 13 and my personal coach from when I was a baby.
sentence_pairs.cn: 他是我童年俱乐部德拉门斯特朗的教练，后来直到我十三岁一直带斯特罗姆加德，而从我还在襁褓里时起，他就是我的私人教练。

sentence_pairs.en: He’d played in the top division in Norway as a midfielder, so if I wasn’t playing with my friends, I was training with him.
sentence_pairs.cn: 他当过挪威顶级联赛的中场，所以只要我没在跟朋友们踢球，我就在跟他训练。

sentence_pairs.en: Really training.
sentence_pairs.cn: 是很认真的那种训练。

sentence_pairs.en: Maybe you think you know the story?
sentence_pairs.cn: 也许你以为你知道这个故事？

sentence_pairs.en: Pushy dad making his son practice every day.
sentence_pairs.cn: 逼着儿子天天练球的虎爸。

sentence_pairs.en: But actually it was the opposite.
sentence_pairs.cn: 其实恰恰相反。

sentence_pairs.en: I was the one pushing him.
sentence_pairs.cn: 是我追着他要练。

sentence_pairs.en: He knew things the other parents didn't.
sentence_pairs.cn: 他知道别的家长不知道的东西。

sentence_pairs.en: So I wanted him to teach me, to give me an edge.
sentence_pairs.cn: 所以我想让他教我，让我比别人多一点优势。

sentence_pairs.en: He was particularly obsessed with me developing my awareness and quick feet.
sentence_pairs.cn: 他特别执着于练我的观察意识和脚下频率。

sentence_pairs.en: He was always getting me to look over my shoulder before receiving the ball.
sentence_pairs.cn: 接球前回头的观察，是他一直逼着我养成的习惯。

sentence_pairs.en: In winter, when we couldn’t play outside, he took me to the indoor sports hall and we would do drills where he’d play the ball off a bench and it would bounce back to me.
sentence_pairs.cn: 冬天没法在室外踢，他就带我去室内体育馆，做那种他把球往长凳上一踢、球反弹回来的练习。

sentence_pairs.en: He would come up behind, pressing me from one side and I had to look and adjust before receiving it.
sentence_pairs.cn: 他会从背后上来，从一侧逼抢我，我必须先观察、再调整，然后才能接球。

sentence_pairs.en: These days, when you see me turn away from a defender, using that touch and quick reading of the game, that’s the sports hall.
sentence_pairs.cn: 如今你们看到我背身摆脱防守队员，用那种触球和对比赛的快速阅读——那就是那间体育馆。

sentence_pairs.en: That’s my dad.
sentence_pairs.cn: 那就是我爸。

sentence_pairs.en: I was so focused on being the best at that time.
sentence_pairs.cn: 那时候我满脑子只想做到最好。

sentence_pairs.en: I knew I was talented but I wasn’t getting ahead of myself.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我知道自己有天赋，但我没有飘飘然。

sentence_pairs.en: I was just enjoying playing with my friends for my hometown club.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我只是在享受和朋友们一起为家乡俱乐部踢球。

sentence_pairs.en: Then things started progressing really fast.
sentence_pairs.cn: 然后一切都开始加速。

sentence_pairs.en: When I was 13, I made my debut for Strømsgodset.
sentence_pairs.cn: 十三岁，我完成了斯特罗姆加德的首秀。

sentence_pairs.en: When I was 15, I became the youngest player to play for the Norway national team.
sentence_pairs.cn: 十五岁，我成了代表挪威国家队出场的最年轻球员。

sentence_pairs.en: That’s when things really went crazy.
sentence_pairs.cn: 从那时起，一切真的疯狂起来。

sentence_pairs.en: I remember coming on for the last 20 minutes of a Euro 2016 qualifier against Bulgaria at the Ullevaal Stadion in Oslo and the whole stadium, more than 20,000 people, going mad.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我记得2016年欧洲杯预选赛对保加利亚，在奥斯陆的乌勒瓦尔球场，我第70分钟左右替补登场，全场两万多人瞬间疯狂。

sentence_pairs.en: Every time I touched the ball, they cheered.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我每次触球，他们都在欢呼。

sentence_pairs.en: I can still hear that sound.
sentence_pairs.cn: 那个声音我到现在都记得。

sentence_pairs.en: The thing is, in Norway, we hadn’t had a “superstar” in such a long time that the fans were a little desperate and when they started hearing this talk about this young guy from Drammen, they just wanted to believe it, even if they didn't actually know if I was any good.
sentence_pairs.cn: 事情是这样的：挪威已经太久没有出过“超级巨星”了，球迷们有点饥渴；当他们开始听到关于这个德拉门小伙子的传闻，他们就是想相信，哪怕他们其实并不确定我到底行不行。

sentence_pairs.en: It added to this strange hype.
sentence_pairs.cn: 这又给那股奇怪的热度添了一把火。

sentence_pairs.en: And then the hype just builds more hype, and suddenly you’re linked with Real Madrid.
sentence_pairs.cn: 然后热度会生出更多热度，突然之间，你就和皇马联系在一起了。

sentence_pairs.en: My dad handled everything with the clubs, and there were a lot.
sentence_pairs.cn: 和各家俱乐部的接洽都由我爸打理，找上门的非常多。

sentence_pairs.en: We went to Bayern, Dortmund, Man Utd, Liverpool, Madrid, Arsenal too.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我们去过拜仁、多特蒙德、曼联、利物浦、皇马，也有阿森纳。

sentence_pairs.en: We got flown around in private planes and made to feel special.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我们坐私人飞机飞来飞去，处处被当成贵客。

sentence_pairs.en: I’m not just saying this…
sentence_pairs.cn: 我不是在夸张……

sentence_pairs.en: I was actually close to choosing Arsenal.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我当时真的很接近选阿森纳。

sentence_pairs.en: When we went there, I got to train at London Colney.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我们去那里的时候，我在伦敦科尔尼训练基地训练过。

sentence_pairs.en: I met Arsène Wenger.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我见到了温格。

sentence_pairs.en: He took me and Dad out for dinner.
sentence_pairs.cn: 他还带我和我爸出去吃了顿饭。

sentence_pairs.en: That was cool, but strange too.
sentence_pairs.cn: 很酷，但也很奇怪。

sentence_pairs.en: It’s Arsène Wenger, you know?
sentence_pairs.cn: 那可是温格啊，你懂吗？

sentence_pairs.en: He’s this legend I grew up watching on TV, and now I’m sitting across from him eating steak.
sentence_pairs.cn: 他是我在电视上看大的传奇，现在我却坐在他对面吃牛排。

sentence_pairs.en: I was so nervous I was just sitting there thinking, Is he analysing me right now?
sentence_pairs.cn: 我紧张得要命，坐在那儿满脑子想的是：他是不是正在分析我？

sentence_pairs.en: Is he going to judge me if I eat the fries?
sentence_pairs.cn: 我要是吃了薯条，他会给我打低分吗？

sentence_pairs.en: Maybe I should just leave them.
sentence_pairs.cn: 要不我还是别碰了。

sentence_pairs.en: Hahaha!
sentence_pairs.cn: 哈哈哈！

sentence_pairs.en: So, why Real Madrid then?
sentence_pairs.cn: 那么，为什么最后是皇马？

sentence_pairs.en: I talked about it a lot with my dad and the rest of my family.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我和我爸、和全家人反复讨论过。

sentence_pairs.en: In the end, Madrid is Madrid.
sentence_pairs.cn: 说到底，皇马就是皇马。

sentence_pairs.en: They were the Champions League holders with the best players in the world.
sentence_pairs.cn: 他们是欧冠卫冕冠军，拥有世界上最强的球员。

sentence_pairs.en: Back then, I loved Isco — he was so smooth on the ball.
sentence_pairs.cn: 那时候我很喜欢伊斯科——他拿球那么丝滑。

sentence_pairs.en: Another one of my kind of players!
sentence_pairs.cn: 又是一个我喜欢的类型！

sentence_pairs.en: But the really key thing about Madrid’s offer was that they had a B team where I could play competitive football immediately.
sentence_pairs.cn: 但皇马这份报价里真正关键的东西，是他们的B队——我可以立刻踢上有竞争力的正式比赛。

sentence_pairs.en: And the manager of that team?
sentence_pairs.cn: 而那支球队的教练是谁？

sentence_pairs.en: Zinedine Zidane.
sentence_pairs.cn: 齐内丁·齐达内。

sentence_pairs.en: It felt like the total package.
sentence_pairs.cn: 感觉这就是一份完美套餐。

sentence_pairs.en: Before we officially told them, I remember sitting with my dad on the sofa watching a Real Madrid game on TV.
sentence_pairs.cn: 在正式答复之前，我记得我和我爸坐在沙发上，看皇马的比赛。

sentence_pairs.en: At one point, he turned to me with his phone in his hand like, “Is it time?
sentence_pairs.cn: 看着看着，他忽然拿着手机转向我：“是时候了吗？

sentence_pairs.en: Should we tell them?”
sentence_pairs.cn: 咱们告诉他们吧？”

sentence_pairs.en: We’d been speaking about the decision for so long, as it was so hard to turn down all these other amazing clubs.
sentence_pairs.cn: 这个决定我们已经讨论了很久，因为拒绝那些同样出色的俱乐部实在太难。

sentence_pairs.en: But then we did it.
sentence_pairs.cn: 然后我们就发了。

sentence_pairs.en: He’d had the draft saved in his phone for like a week or two already.
sentence_pairs.cn: 那条信息在他手机里存了大概一两个星期。

sentence_pairs.en: This really simple message.
sentence_pairs.cn: 非常简单的一句话。

sentence_pairs.en: It was something like: “Martin has decided he wants to come, if you still want him.”
sentence_pairs.cn: 大意是：“马丁决定要来，如果你们还要他的话。”

sentence_pairs.en: I just told him, “Send it.”
sentence_pairs.cn: 我只跟他说：“发吧。”

sentence_pairs.en: Let’s talk about my presentation day.
sentence_pairs.cn: 来说说我的亮相日吧。

sentence_pairs.en: I’m actually cringing thinking about it now…
sentence_pairs.cn: 现在想起来我都会脚趾抠地……

sentence_pairs.en: but I know a lot of people talked about this at the time.
sentence_pairs.cn: 但我知道当时很多人都在议论这件事。

sentence_pairs.en: I was basically a meme.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我基本上成了一个表情包。

sentence_pairs.en: So let me clear up what happened.
sentence_pairs.cn: 那让我来还原一下当时发生了什么。

sentence_pairs.en: They sent a plane to pick us up from Norway in the morning.
sentence_pairs.cn: 早上他们派了一架飞机来挪威接我们。

sentence_pairs.en: Really early.
sentence_pairs.cn: 非常早。

sentence_pairs.en: So, I wake up but I’m still half asleep.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我醒了，但还半睡半醒。

sentence_pairs.en: My hair is all over the place.
sentence_pairs.cn: 头发炸得到处都是。

sentence_pairs.en: I didn’t have time to shower.
sentence_pairs.cn: 来不及洗澡。

sentence_pairs.en: I just put on whatever clothes I could grab quickly, throw something smarter into a bag and we take the flight.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我随手抓了几件衣服套上，往包里塞了件稍微体面的，就上了飞机。

sentence_pairs.en: I figure that once I arrive at the hotel in Madrid I can get changed, take a shower, prepare myself, you know?
sentence_pairs.cn: 我心想，等到了马德里的酒店，我可以换衣服、洗个澡、收拾一下自己，对吧？

sentence_pairs.en: But then we land, we get off the plane and I realise they are taking us directly to the training ground to do the medical and then the press conference.
sentence_pairs.cn: 结果飞机落地，下了舷梯我才发现，他们要直接带我们去训练基地体检，然后开发布会。

sentence_pairs.en: No hotel stop.
sentence_pairs.cn: 酒店？没有这一站。

sentence_pairs.en: And I’m like, Wait, we’re doing this now?
sentence_pairs.cn: 我心想：等等，现在就来吗？

sentence_pairs.en: Suddenly, I’m sitting next to Madrid legend Emilio Butragueño — who’s wearing a really smart suit, of course — and they are introducing me to the world.
sentence_pairs.cn: 突然之间，我坐在皇马传奇布特拉格诺旁边——他当然穿着一身非常精神的西装——他们正在把我介绍给全世界。

sentence_pairs.en: I know you’ve seen the pictures.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我知道你们看过那些照片。

sentence_pairs.en: Me, in this old stripey jumper, not even showered, trying to flatten my hair with my hands.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我，穿着那件旧条纹毛衣，澡都没洗，用手拼命压着头发。

sentence_pairs.en: This was the biggest day of my life, images going all over the world.
sentence_pairs.cn: 那是我人生中最大的一天，照片传遍了全世界。

sentence_pairs.en: I’m supposed to be this player that Real Madrid has beaten everyone to sign and I look like a random school kid they just pulled from the stadium tour.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我本该是那个皇马力压群雄签下的天才，看上去却像他们刚从球场参观团里随便拉来的中学生。

sentence_pairs.en: Butragueño is introducing me and in my head I’m like:
sentence_pairs.cn: 布特拉格诺在做介绍，我心里想的是：

sentence_pairs.en: God, I wish I’d changed my jumper.
sentence_pairs.cn: 天哪，真希望我换了件毛衣。

sentence_pairs.en: Someone could’ve told me.
sentence_pairs.cn: 怎么没人提醒我一声。

sentence_pairs.en: Why didn’t anyone tell me????
sentence_pairs.cn: 为什么没有任何人告诉我？？？

sentence_pairs.en: Hahaha!
sentence_pairs.cn: 哈哈哈！

sentence_pairs.en: The other thing I’m thinking about at that moment, sitting there in front of all these people, is my Confirmation.
sentence_pairs.cn: 那一刻，坐在这么多人面前，我脑子里想的另一件事，是我的坚振礼。

sentence_pairs.en: If you don’t know, it’s a common ceremony for kids in Norway to go through where you celebrate becoming an adult.
sentence_pairs.cn: 如果你不了解，这是挪威孩子都会经历的一种成人仪式。

sentence_pairs.en: I did mine when I was 15.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我十五岁时办的。

sentence_pairs.en: It’s just for family and close friends and it’s normal that at the end of the event, the kid gets up to do a short speech to thank everyone for coming.
sentence_pairs.cn: 只有家人和好友参加，按惯例仪式的最后，过礼的孩子要站起来做个简短致辞，感谢大家的到来。

sentence_pairs.en: Except at mine, I froze.
sentence_pairs.cn: 可轮到我的时候，我僵住了。

sentence_pairs.en: I was too shy to speak in front of my family — the people I’m most comfortable with!
sentence_pairs.cn: 在最让我放松的人——我的家人——面前，我居然紧张得说不出话！

sentence_pairs.en: I was confident on the football pitch, but speaking in front of people?
sentence_pairs.cn: 在球场上我信心十足，可要当众讲话？

sentence_pairs.en: No way.
sentence_pairs.cn: 没门。

sentence_pairs.en: One year later, I’m front and centre at a Real Madrid press conference.
sentence_pairs.cn: 一年之后，我就坐在了皇马发布会的正中央。

sentence_pairs.en: In this stripey jumper.
sentence_pairs.cn: 穿着那件条纹毛衣。

sentence_pairs.en: Haha can you imagine??
sentence_pairs.cn: 哈哈你能想象吗？？

sentence_pairs.en: I was so out of my comfort zone.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我完全不在自己的舒适区。

sentence_pairs.en: You can see the fear in my face.
sentence_pairs.cn: 你能从我脸上看到恐惧。

sentence_pairs.en: When it’s my turn to speak, I have these big headphones on and I’m practically whispering in Norwegian like, “Uh yeah…
sentence_pairs.cn: 轮到我发言时，我戴着巨大的同传耳机，用挪威语小声嘀咕：“呃，好的……

sentence_pairs.en: It’s a great pleasure.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我很荣幸。

sentence_pairs.en: Ummm, I’m very proud.…”
sentence_pairs.cn: 嗯……我非常骄傲……”

sentence_pairs.en: But in a weird way, I think that moment actually helped a lot of people’s perceptions of me.
sentence_pairs.cn: 但说来奇怪，我觉得那个瞬间反而改变了很多人对我的看法。

sentence_pairs.en: As soon as you get famous, people expect you to be a certain way.
sentence_pairs.cn: 人一出名，别人就会期待你按某种方式活着。

sentence_pairs.en: Like you’re this superhero, who can do anything.
sentence_pairs.cn: 好像你是个无所不能的超级英雄。

sentence_pairs.en: You can play football, so you also must be able to speak well, be confident, give everything of yourself at all times.
sentence_pairs.cn: 你会踢球，所以你也必须会讲话、必须自信、必须随时随地掏出全部的自己。

sentence_pairs.en: But that’s not realistic.
sentence_pairs.cn: 可这不现实。

sentence_pairs.en: I think that press conference helped people connect to what I was going through.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我觉得那场发布会让人们理解了我当时的处境。

sentence_pairs.en: I was just this shy little kid.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我只是一个害羞的小孩。

sentence_pairs.en: I mean, have you met a 16-year-old recently?
sentence_pairs.cn: 这么说吧，你最近见过十六岁的孩子吗？

sentence_pairs.en: They felt for me and saw how normal I was.
sentence_pairs.cn: 他们心疼我，也看到了我有多普通。

sentence_pairs.en: A few days after the presentation, I went into training for the first time and, honestly, that was just surreal.
sentence_pairs.cn: 亮相几天后，我第一次去一线队训练，说实话，那感觉超现实。

sentence_pairs.en: I’m not old enough to drive, so my dad actually has to bring me in to play with Isco and Ronaldo and Ramos and Modric and Bale and Benzema, like he’s dropping me off at school.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我还没到开车的年纪，得由我爸送我去和伊斯科、C罗、拉莫斯、莫德里奇、贝尔、本泽马一起训练，就像送我上学一样。

sentence_pairs.en: All I’m thinking is about how these guys will treat me when I walk into their dressing room.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我满脑子想的都是：走进他们的更衣室时，这些大人物会怎么对我。

sentence_pairs.en: This little kid who didn’t speak any Spanish.
sentence_pairs.cn: 一个西班牙语都不会说的小屁孩。

sentence_pairs.en: But they were all very kind, and the ones who spoke English — Kroos, Modric, Ronaldo — took extra care of me in the beginning.
sentence_pairs.cn: 但他们都非常友善，会说英语的那几个——克罗斯、莫德里奇、C罗——一开始还格外照顾我。

sentence_pairs.en: They gave me advice and helped me a lot.
sentence_pairs.cn: 他们给我建议，帮了我很多。

sentence_pairs.en: But honestly I don’t think any of them were particularly worried about a 16-year-old from Norway taking their place in the team.
sentence_pairs.cn: 不过说实话，我想他们谁也没怎么担心过一个来自挪威的十六岁小孩会抢走他们的位置。

sentence_pairs.en: We made this plan with the club that I would train every day with the first team but get regular game time with the B team.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我们和俱乐部定了一个计划：我每天跟一线队训练，但定期跟B队打比赛。

sentence_pairs.en: It seemed like a smart plan at the time, but it worked out that I ended up not finding my place with either group.
sentence_pairs.cn: 当时看着很聪明，结果却是我两边都没找到归属。

sentence_pairs.en: With the B team, I wasn’t with them regularly so I didn’t find that connection.
sentence_pairs.cn: 在B队，我不常在，融不进那个集体。

sentence_pairs.en: In the first team, I was just some kid who came to train.
sentence_pairs.cn: 在一线队，我只是个来训练的小孩。

sentence_pairs.en: I wasn’t involved in matches.
sentence_pairs.cn: 比赛没有我的份。

sentence_pairs.en: I felt a bit like an outsider.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我有点像个局外人。

sentence_pairs.en: I was stuck in between.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我卡在中间。

sentence_pairs.en: I stopped playing with the spark that was typical of my game.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我踢球失去了那种标志性的火花。

sentence_pairs.en: I went a bit too safe for a time.
sentence_pairs.cn: 有段时间我踢得太过保守。

sentence_pairs.en: I was worrying more about not making mistakes than actually playing my game.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我更怕犯错，而不是去做自己真正擅长的事。

sentence_pairs.en: And my game was always about making a difference.
sentence_pairs.cn: 而我的足球，从来都是关于改变比赛的。

sentence_pairs.en: Playing the difficult pass.
sentence_pairs.cn: 传出那些刁钻的球。

sentence_pairs.en: I can understand why it happened now.
sentence_pairs.cn: 现在我理解这一切是怎么发生的了。

sentence_pairs.en: I was still a little kid, but I’ve learned that you have to be ruthless.
sentence_pairs.cn: 那时我还是个小孩，但我后来懂得：你必须狠。

sentence_pairs.en: You have to not give a f***.
sentence_pairs.cn: 你必须豁出去，谁的脸色都不看。

sentence_pairs.en: You have to show the real you on the pitch.
sentence_pairs.cn: 你必须把真实的自己亮在球场上。

sentence_pairs.en: After a couple of years, I just wasn’t progressing.
sentence_pairs.cn: 几年过去，我没有进步。

sentence_pairs.en: The press came after me for not immediately living up to the hype.
sentence_pairs.cn: 媒体开始围攻我，因为我没有立刻兑现那些吹捧。

sentence_pairs.en: I was an easy target.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我是个好靶子。

sentence_pairs.en: If you really know me, you know I smile a lot, but I think from the outside sometimes my face looks more grumpy than I actually am!
sentence_pairs.cn: 如果你真的了解我，你知道我其实很爱笑，但我猜从外面看，我的脸有时显得比实际更臭！

sentence_pairs.en: It made it easier for them to write about how I was struggling to adapt.
sentence_pairs.cn: 这让他们写“我难以适应”更容易了。

sentence_pairs.en: I remember reading a headline like: “NOW IT’S MAKE OR BREAK TIME FOR MARTIN ØDEGAARD”
sentence_pairs.cn: 我记得读过一个大标题：“马丁·厄德高，现在是成是败的关键时刻”

sentence_pairs.en: And I’m like, make or break?
sentence_pairs.cn: 我心想：成或败？

sentence_pairs.en: I’m 18 years old!
sentence_pairs.cn: 我才十八岁！

sentence_pairs.en: Maybe if I’d been Spanish, I might have been given a bit more time to grow.
sentence_pairs.cn: 如果我是个西班牙球员，也许人们会多给我一些成长的时间。

sentence_pairs.en: Honestly, I don’t know.
sentence_pairs.cn: 说实话，我不知道。

sentence_pairs.en: In the end, it’s just the nature of the hype machine.
sentence_pairs.cn: 说到底，这就是热度机器的天性。

sentence_pairs.en: There is no in-between in modern football.
sentence_pairs.cn: 现代足球里没有中间地带。

sentence_pairs.en: You’re either the best signing in history, or you’re sh**.
sentence_pairs.cn: 你要么是史上最佳签约，要么就是垃圾。

sentence_pairs.en: Listen, I want to make it clear that I am not complaining about my time at Real Madrid.
sentence_pairs.cn: 听着，我想说清楚：我不是在抱怨皇马时光。

sentence_pairs.en: Not at all.
sentence_pairs.cn: 完全没有。

sentence_pairs.en: Going to Madrid was a good thing for me.
sentence_pairs.cn: 去马德里对我来说是好事。

sentence_pairs.en: I learned so much about what it takes to reach the top.
sentence_pairs.cn: 关于登顶需要付出什么，我学到了太多。

sentence_pairs.en: I watched, trained and learned from the best players in the world, my idols.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我观察着、训练着，向世界上最强的球员、我的偶像们学习。

sentence_pairs.en: I played at the Bernabéu.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我在伯纳乌踢过球。

sentence_pairs.en: I learned to be tough and to face challenges.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我学会了坚强，学会了直面挑战。

sentence_pairs.en: It’s part of who I am now.
sentence_pairs.cn: 这已经是我的一部分。

sentence_pairs.en: It’s the reason I’m where I am today.
sentence_pairs.cn: 正因如此，我才有今天。

sentence_pairs.en: But when things got tough, I never lost sight of the bigger picture.
sentence_pairs.cn: 但当日子变得艰难时，我从未丢掉对大局的判断。

sentence_pairs.en: In my head I was always like, How can I change?
sentence_pairs.cn: 我心里始终想的是：我怎么改变？

sentence_pairs.en: How can I get better?
sentence_pairs.cn: 我怎么变强？

sentence_pairs.en: Because in the end, I will never be the guy who is happy to just train at the biggest club and maybe get a few minutes here and there.
sentence_pairs.cn: 因为说到底，我永远不会做那种“在最大的俱乐部训练训练、偶尔捞几分钟上场就很满足”的人。

sentence_pairs.en: I was always thinking about what I needed to do to be the best version of me I could be.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我一直在想，要怎样做才能成为最好的自己。

sentence_pairs.en: That’s why I needed to move on.
sentence_pairs.cn: 这就是我必须继续前进的原因。

sentence_pairs.en: Back when I was coming up in Norway, it seemed like I had all the options in the world.
sentence_pairs.cn: 当年在挪威蹿红的时候，我似乎手握全世界的选项。

sentence_pairs.en: Only a couple of years later, I had to come to terms with the fact that clubs weren’t lining up for me anymore.
sentence_pairs.cn: 仅仅几年之后，我就不得不接受：俱乐部们已经不再排着队要我了。

sentence_pairs.en: If you’re playing Career Mode and you go from Real Madrid to Heerenveen, maybe you think something has gone wrong.
sentence_pairs.cn: 如果你在生涯模式里从皇马转会去海伦芬，也许你会觉得哪里出问题了。

sentence_pairs.en: No offence to the Dutch league!
sentence_pairs.cn: 没有冒犯荷甲的意思！

sentence_pairs.en: But honestly, for me, it was a fantastic experience.
sentence_pairs.cn: 但说实话，对我而言，那是一段绝佳的经历。

sentence_pairs.en: I got to play regularly at first-team level, which was exactly what I needed.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我获得了一线队的稳定出场，这正是我需要的。

sentence_pairs.en: I owe a lot to my loans at Heerenveen, where I grew as a person, and Vitesse, where I grew as a player.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我很感激在海伦芬和维特斯的租借——在海伦芬我作为一个人成长了，在维特斯我作为一名球员成长了。

sentence_pairs.en: At Heerenveen, I got my driving licence (I didn’t need my dad taking me to training anymore), I learned to be by myself and to take responsibility.
sentence_pairs.cn: 在海伦芬，我考下了驾照（再也不用我爸送我去训练了），学会了独立生活、自己扛责任。

sentence_pairs.en: Then at Vitesse, I met the manager Leonid Slutsky.
sentence_pairs.cn: 然后到了维特斯，我遇到了主教练莱昂尼德·斯卢茨基。

sentence_pairs.en: He was amazing.
sentence_pairs.cn: 他非常出色。

sentence_pairs.en: He believed in my ability without asking me to be magical every time.
sentence_pairs.cn: 他相信我的能力，却从不要求我每次都变魔术。

sentence_pairs.en: He improved my decision making and teamwork.
sentence_pairs.cn: 他提升了我的决策和团队配合。

sentence_pairs.en: Soon I was finding the difficult passes again.
sentence_pairs.cn: 很快，我又开始传出那些刁钻的球了。

sentence_pairs.en: After two and a half seasons on loan in the Netherlands, I was ready to come back to La Liga and settle down at Real Sociedad for at least two seasons.
sentence_pairs.cn: 在荷兰租借的两个半赛季之后，我已经准备好回到西甲，在皇家社会安顿下来，至少踢两个赛季。

sentence_pairs.en: In the end, it didn’t work out that way.
sentence_pairs.cn: 最终，事情没有按那个剧本走。

sentence_pairs.en: It’s an amazing club in a beautiful part of the world, with fans that are so connected to their team.
sentence_pairs.cn: 那是一家了不起的俱乐部，坐落在世界上一片美丽的角落，球迷和球队血肉相连。

sentence_pairs.en: In a way, the Basque culture is more like Norway.
sentence_pairs.cn: 某种意义上，巴斯克文化更像挪威。

sentence_pairs.en: People are more reserved on the outside but once they take you into their hearts, they are so caring and protective.
sentence_pairs.cn: 人们外表比较内敛，可一旦你走进他们心里，他们无比体贴、无比护短。

sentence_pairs.en: You become one of their own.
sentence_pairs.cn: 你会成为“他们自己人”。

sentence_pairs.en: I loved that.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我爱极了这一点。

sentence_pairs.en: I was playing well and I was really happy there, but after a year when Madrid called I thought, I have to take this chance now.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我踢得很好，在那里非常开心，但一年后皇马来电话时，我心想：这个机会我现在必须抓住。

sentence_pairs.en: This is the dream I’ve been following since I was 16.
sentence_pairs.cn: 这是我从十六岁起就追随的梦想。

sentence_pairs.en: I had a good connection with Zidane from when he coached the B team and he took good care of me, so I wanted to believe it would work out this time.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我和齐达内在他带B队时就关系很好，他一直很照顾我，所以我愿意相信这一次会成。

sentence_pairs.en: But then I got COVID.
sentence_pairs.cn: 但我得了新冠。

sentence_pairs.en: I started the first two games of that season in 2020-21, but I wasn’t fully recovered.
sentence_pairs.cn: 2020-21赛季的前两场我都是首发，但我没有完全恢复。

sentence_pairs.en: I didn’t perform at my best and after that, I didn’t get many more chances.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我没能拿出最好的状态，之后机会就变得寥寥。

sentence_pairs.en: Almost nothing.
sentence_pairs.cn: 几乎为零。

sentence_pairs.en: Meanwhile, I’m watching Real Sociedad on TV thinking, I could’ve still been there.
sentence_pairs.cn: 与此同时，我在电视上看皇家社会的比赛，心想：我本来还可以留在那儿的。

sentence_pairs.en: I was thinking about this a lot.
sentence_pairs.cn: 这个问题我想了很久。

sentence_pairs.en: I spoke to my agent ahead of the January transfer window, “Look, we need to do something…
sentence_pairs.cn: 一月转会窗之前我跟经纪人说：“听着，我们得做点什么……

sentence_pairs.en: I didn’t come back to just be there.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我回来不是为了坐着的。

sentence_pairs.en: I came back here to play.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我回来是为了上场。

sentence_pairs.en: I need to play and keep improving.”
sentence_pairs.cn: 我需要比赛，需要持续进步。”

sentence_pairs.en: He tried to calm me down, telling me we’d just cancelled one contract to come back to Madrid.
sentence_pairs.cn: 他想让我冷静，说我们刚毁约了一次才回的马德里。

sentence_pairs.en: I’d always said I wanted stability and now five months later I wanted to move again?
sentence_pairs.cn: 我一直说要稳定，结果五个月后又要走？

sentence_pairs.en: But I had made up my mind.
sentence_pairs.cn: 但我已经拿定了主意。

sentence_pairs.en: I can only thank Madrid for investing in a 16-year-old kid.
sentence_pairs.cn: 对于皇马在一个十六岁孩子身上的投入，我只有感激。

sentence_pairs.en: Everybody had good intentions and I don’t blame anyone, but I needed to find a place where I could settle.
sentence_pairs.cn: 每个人都出于好意，我不怪任何人，但我需要找到一个能扎根的地方。

sentence_pairs.en: I needed to find an actual home.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我需要一个真正的家。

sentence_pairs.en: I found it in North London.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我在北伦敦找到了它。

sentence_pairs.en: Career Mode.
sentence_pairs.cn: 生涯模式。

sentence_pairs.en: This little memory in the back of my mind just flashed up the second my agent mentioned that Arsenal were interested.
sentence_pairs.cn: 经纪人一提到阿森纳有意，我脑海深处的那段小记忆就闪了出来。

sentence_pairs.en: It just felt right.
sentence_pairs.cn: 就是觉得对了。

sentence_pairs.en: I spoke to Mikel Arteta on a Zoom call and he told me all about the project.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我和米克尔·阿尔特塔视频通话，他给我讲了整个计划。

sentence_pairs.en: At the time, Arsenal were not doing well.
sentence_pairs.cn: 那时阿森纳处境不好。

sentence_pairs.en: They were way down like 15th in the table, but that meeting…
sentence_pairs.cn: 联赛排名掉到了第十五左右，但那次谈话……

sentence_pairs.en: Honestly, I challenge anyone to come away from a meeting with Arteta and not believe everything he tells you.
sentence_pairs.cn: 说实话，我敢向任何人挑战：跟阿尔特塔谈完，你不可能不信他说的一切。

sentence_pairs.en: He is next level.
sentence_pairs.cn: 他是另一个级别的。

sentence_pairs.en: It's hard to explain.
sentence_pairs.cn: 很难解释。

sentence_pairs.en: He’s passionate, he’s intense and sometimes, yeah, he’s a bit crazy…
sentence_pairs.cn: 他有激情、有强度，有时候，嗯，是有点疯……

sentence_pairs.en: but when he speaks, you understand that whatever he says will happen, will happen.
sentence_pairs.cn: 但当他开口，你会明白：他说会发生的事，就会发生。

sentence_pairs.en: He told me his plan, everything he was building towards.
sentence_pairs.cn: 他跟我讲了计划，讲了他正在打造的一切。

sentence_pairs.en: He knew exactly what needed to change at the club.
sentence_pairs.cn: 他很清楚俱乐部哪里需要改变。

sentence_pairs.en: He told me all about these amazing young players in the squad — Saka, Martinelli, Smith Rowe, etc., etc. He told me how he wanted me to fit in and how I was going to improve.
sentence_pairs.cn: 他给我讲了队里那些出色的年轻人——萨卡、马丁内利、史密斯·罗，等等等等。他讲了想让我怎样融入，我会怎样进步。

sentence_pairs.en: I got this strong feeling that he was onto something really special.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我有一种强烈的预感：他正在成就一番真正特别的事业。

sentence_pairs.en: Not that I needed any more convincing but I also got so many messages from Arsenal fans on Instagram telling me to sign.
sentence_pairs.cn: 倒不需要更多说服，Instagram 上还有成千上万的阿森纳球迷给我发消息催我签约。

sentence_pairs.en: Not just me, my whole family, friends and everyone I follow!
sentence_pairs.cn: 不只是我，我全家人、朋友们、我关注的所有人都在收！

sentence_pairs.en: It’s such an amazing, active fan base.
sentence_pairs.cn: 这球迷群体真是又热情又活跃。

sentence_pairs.en: Random people I know would show me how the comments on their posts were full of stuff like “Tell Martin to sign for Arsenal.”
sentence_pairs.cn: 我认识的一些普通人会给我看，他们帖子底下的评论全都是“让马丁签阿森纳”。

sentence_pairs.en: That was just…
sentence_pairs.cn: 那感觉真是……

sentence_pairs.en: Wow.
sentence_pairs.cn: 哇。

sentence_pairs.en: I have to say, the fans have been amazing since I’ve been here.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我必须说，自从我来到这里，球迷一直太棒了。

sentence_pairs.en: Maybe some people think that doesn't matter to us as players, but it matters.
sentence_pairs.cn: 也许有人觉得这对我们球员不重要，但它重要。

sentence_pairs.en: At the Emirates, every time you make a tackle to knock the ball out for a throw-in, the whole stadium cheers like you've scored a goal.
sentence_pairs.cn: 在酋长球场，哪怕你只是一次把球铲出边线的防守，全场都会像你进球一样欢呼。

sentence_pairs.en: They give you this confidence that you can do anything.
sentence_pairs.cn: 他们给你一种“你什么都能做到”的自信。

sentence_pairs.en: At the end of my first season here in 2020-21, when we finished eighth, it seemed like no one at the club lost faith in what we were doing.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我在这里的第一个赛季，2020-21赛季末我们排第八，俱乐部里似乎没有人对我们正在做的事失去信心。

sentence_pairs.en: Everyone believed in us.
sentence_pairs.cn: 所有人都相信我们。

sentence_pairs.en: It was all part of the plan.
sentence_pairs.cn: 这都是计划的一部分。

sentence_pairs.en: Even last season when things got really tough.
sentence_pairs.cn: 哪怕上赛季那么艰难的时候也一样。

sentence_pairs.en: Obviously, we took it hard losing out on Champions League qualification when it was in our hands like that, but we learned from that experience.
sentence_pairs.cn: 显然，眼看着欧冠资格攥在手里却最终错失，我们都很痛苦，但我们从那段经历里学到了东西。

sentence_pairs.en: We came back closer, stronger, hungrier.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我们以更团结、更强壮、更饥饿的姿态回归。

sentence_pairs.en: We’re in the title race now, but there’s a long way to go and, trust me, no one is thinking about May yet.
sentence_pairs.cn: 现在我们在争冠行列，但路还很长，相信我，还没有人开始想五月的事。

sentence_pairs.en: It’s a cliché but we are taking it game by game, training session by training session.
sentence_pairs.cn: 话虽老套，我们就是一场一场地踢，一练一练地练。

sentence_pairs.en: One piece at a time.
sentence_pairs.cn: 一块砖一块砖地砌。

sentence_pairs.en: I will say this, though, if there’s anyone left who still doesn’t fully believe in this team, take it from me: there are no limits on what we can achieve.
sentence_pairs.cn: 不过我要说：如果还有人没有完全相信这支球队，听我一句——我们能达到的高度没有上限。

sentence_pairs.en: No one can tell me otherwise.
sentence_pairs.cn: 谁说什么我都不能同意。

sentence_pairs.en: I’m so proud to be captain of this club and I feel like I’m going to be here a long time.
sentence_pairs.cn: 能担任这家俱乐部的队长，我无比自豪，而且我感觉自己会在这里待很久。

sentence_pairs.en: After the win over West Ham on Boxing Day, I got the chance to speak to Wenger — it was the first time he’d been back to the Emirates since 2018, and the first time I’d seen him since that steak and fries all those years ago.
sentence_pairs.cn: 节礼日赢下西汉姆之后，我有机会和温格聊了聊——那是2018年以来他第一次回到酋长球场，也是自当年那顿牛排薯条之后，我第一次见他。

sentence_pairs.en: We had a good chat and he mentioned that he’d kept a close eye on my career even after I chose Madrid.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我们聊得很愉快。他说即使在我选择皇马之后，他也一直关注着我的职业生涯。

sentence_pairs.en: He was honest and said that at one point he was actually worried about the way things were going for me, but now he’s so happy to see me doing well in the right environment.
sentence_pairs.cn: 他很坦诚，说有一阵子他真的为我的处境担心过，但现在看到我在对的环境里过得很好，他非常高兴。

sentence_pairs.en: He’d recognised something.
sentence_pairs.cn: 他看出了某种东西。

sentence_pairs.en: Ever since I left Norway, it’s like everything has felt sort of temporary.
sentence_pairs.cn: 离开挪威之后，一切都像是临时性的。

sentence_pairs.en: I haven’t had that stability, that real deep connection, until now, and that’s so important.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我始终没有那种稳定感、那种真正深层的联结，直到现在——而这太重要了。

sentence_pairs.en: Whenever I lead the team out at the Emirates, I have this moment to myself.
sentence_pairs.cn: 每当我在酋长球场率队出场，我都有一个属于自己的瞬间。

sentence_pairs.en: I want to really feel that atmosphere, that electricity from the fans.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我想真正去感受那种氛围，球迷带来的那种电流。

sentence_pairs.en: I always listen as they play North London Forever over the speakers and I start singing along under my breath.
sentence_pairs.cn: 当扬声器里响起 North London Forever，我总会跟着轻声哼唱。

sentence_pairs.en: I get goosebumps every time.
sentence_pairs.cn: 每次都起鸡皮疙瘩。

sentence_pairs.en: I close my eyes, and I think about myself as a kid out on the artificial pitch in Drammen.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我闭上眼睛，想起小时候那个在德拉门人工球场上的自己。

sentence_pairs.en: If you’d have shown that kid a snapshot of this moment and told him this was in his future?
sentence_pairs.cn: 如果你把此刻的画面拿给那个孩子看，告诉他这会是他未来的一部分？

sentence_pairs.en: He would have died for this.
sentence_pairs.cn: 为了这个，他什么都愿意。

sentence_pairs.en: It’s been a hell of a long road, but I’m living my dream.
sentence_pairs.cn: 这是一条长得要命的路，但我正活在自己的梦里。

sentence_pairs.en: I’m home.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我到家了。

sentence_pairs.en: And the best is yet to come.
sentence_pairs.cn: 而最好的，还在后面。

sentences.en: I’ve always had this weird connection to Arsenal.
sentences.cn: 我和阿森纳之间一直有一种奇妙的缘分。

sentences.en: It started long before I signed.
sentences.cn: 它在我签约之前很久就开始了。

sentences.en: I don’t even really know how to explain it, except with one little story.
sentences.cn: 除了用一个小故事来讲，我实在不知道该怎么解释。

sentences.en: I’ve never been that much into video games.
sentences.cn: 我从来不算沉迷电子游戏。

sentences.en: I am of that generation that always played outside, but the one exception was FIFA.
sentences.cn: 我们这一代人总是在外面野，唯一的例外是 FIFA。

sentences.en: I mostly played Career Mode.
sentences.cn: 我基本只玩生涯模式。

sentences.en: You know, where you get to be the manager?
sentences.cn: 就是你可以当主教练的那个模式？

sentences.en: The club I always chose to manage was Arsenal.
sentences.cn: 我一直选来执教的俱乐部，是阿森纳。

sentences.en: They were my FIFA team.
sentences.cn: 那是我的 FIFA 主队。

sentences.en: Growing up in Norway, I watched a lot of Premier League and I just had this good feeling about Arsenal.
sentences.cn: 在挪威长大，我看了很多英超，对阿森纳就是有一种莫名的好感。

sentences.en: I’d seen clips of Thierry Henry and the Invincibles.
sentences.cn: 我看过蒂埃里·亨利和那支“不败之师”的集锦。

sentences.en: I knew the club had a history of developing playmakers like Fabregas, Nasri, Özil — really smart, technical players, who were good on the ball and played the difficult passes.
sentences.cn: 我知道这家俱乐部有培养法布雷加斯、纳斯里、厄齐尔这类组织者的传统——都是那种聪明、有技术、球粘在脚上、敢传刁钻直塞的球员。

sentences.en: My kind of players.
sentences.cn: 正是我喜欢的类型。

sentences.en: As I got older, around the 2015 edition, I started actually appearing in FIFA.
sentences.cn: 等我大一些，大约在 FIFA 2015 那一代，我自己开始真的出现在游戏里了。

sentences.en: I didn’t look much like me at first.
sentences.cn: 一开始长得不太像我。

sentences.en: I think I was like a 67 overall, but I was actually in the game and it was a big deal.
sentences.cn: 我记得总评大概是 67，但我是真的进了游戏，这可是件大事。

sentences.en: So, naturally, one of the first things I did when I was pretending to be Arsène Wenger on Career Mode was to buy myself.
sentences.cn: 所以很自然，当我在生涯模式里扮演温格时，最先做的几件事之一，就是把我自己买进来。

sentences.en: Haha!
sentences.cn: 哈哈！

sentences.en: Me and Arsenal.
sentences.cn: 我和阿森纳。

sentences.en: It just seemed like a good match in my head.
sentences.cn: 在我脑子里，这两者就是般配的。

sentences.en: That special connection turned into a reality when I signed here two years ago.
sentences.cn: 两年前我签约到这里，这份奇妙的缘分变成了现实。

sentences.en: It was a decision that changed my life around.
sentences.cn: 这是一个改变了我人生的决定。

sentences.en: I come into training smiling every day.
sentences.cn: 我每天都是笑着走进训练基地的。

sentences.en: But my story is definitely not Career Mode.
sentences.cn: 但我的故事，肯定不是生涯模式。

sentences.en: This has been a very different journey to how I imagined it on FIFA.
sentences.cn: 这一路走来，和在 FIFA 里想象的完全不同。

sentences.en: In real life, you can’t just select where you want to go and everything will be perfect.
sentences.cn: 现实生活里，你没法选好目的地，然后就一切完美。

sentences.en: People always want to know what it was like for me growing up as a teenager in Norway with all that crazy hype.
sentences.cn: 人们总想知道，一个挪威少年顶着那么疯狂的热度长大，是什么滋味。

sentences.en: And, to be honest, I don’t know how to answer that.
sentences.cn: 说实话，我不知道该怎么回答。

sentences.en: It’s strange to say but, at the time, it felt…
sentences.cn: 说来奇怪，在当时的我看来，那一切……

sentences.en: normal.
sentences.cn: 很平常。

sentences.en: I think I was too young — maybe a little too naive?
sentences.cn: 我想我那时太小了——也许是有点太天真？

sentences.en: — to fully understand, you know?
sentences.cn: ——还没法完全明白，你懂吗？

sentences.en: I think people imagine that I had to avoid everything they were saying about me in the press and live in a bubble, but I didn’t.
sentences.cn: 我以为大家会想象我不得不躲开媒体上关于我的一切言论，活在泡泡里，但我没有。

sentences.en: I actually used to read everything they wrote about me.
sentences.cn: 我其实把媒体写的关于我的东西全读了。

sentences.en: I would literally sit down and read the newspapers.
sentences.cn: 我真的会坐下来，一份一份读报纸。

sentences.en: But I read them like, O.K., cool.
sentences.cn: 但我读起来的反应是：哦，挺好。

sentences.en: That’s nice.
sentences.cn: 不错嘛。

sentences.en: And that was it.
sentences.cn: 然后就没有然后了。

sentences.en: I moved on.
sentences.cn: 该干嘛干嘛。

sentences.en: I had a good family around me, good friends, a good life.
sentences.cn: 我有很好的家人在身边，很好的朋友，很好的生活。

sentences.en: I was just a kid who loved football.
sentences.cn: 我就是一个爱踢球的孩子。

sentences.en: Proper, proper loved it.
sentences.cn: 是真心的、发自己内心的爱。

sentences.en: I was obsessed.
sentences.cn: 我痴迷于此。

sentences.en: There was an artificial pitch right next to my house in Drammen — literally 100 metres away — and I lived there for my entire childhood.
sentences.cn: 在德拉门我家旁边就有一块人工草皮球场——真的就一百米——我在那里度过了整个童年。

sentences.en: Sometimes when I go back home now, I see kids on that same pitch just chatting, taking shots casually and I’m like, what are you doing?!
sentences.cn: 现在有时回老家，我看见孩子们在那块球场上闲聊，随意颠两脚射门，我心想：你们在干嘛？！

sentences.en: That’s not how my friends and I played.
sentences.cn: 我和朋友们可不是这么踢的。

sentences.en: We were out there playing tournaments, one-on-ones until it got dark.
sentences.cn: 我们在那儿打锦标赛、单挑单挑再单挑，一直到天黑。

sentences.en: This was serious.
sentences.cn: 这是很认真的事。

sentences.en: I was also lucky that I had my dad, Hans Erik.
sentences.cn: 我还有一个幸运之处：我有我爸爸，汉斯·埃里克。

sentences.en: He was my club coach at my childhood club Drammen Strong and then at Strømsgodset until I was 13 and my personal coach from when I was a baby.
sentences.cn: 他是我童年俱乐部德拉门斯特朗的教练，后来直到我十三岁一直带斯特罗姆加德，而从我还在襁褓里时起，他就是我的私人教练。

sentences.en: He’d played in the top division in Norway as a midfielder, so if I wasn’t playing with my friends, I was training with him.
sentences.cn: 他当过挪威顶级联赛的中场，所以只要我没在跟朋友们踢球，我就在跟他训练。

sentences.en: Really training.
sentences.cn: 是很认真的那种训练。

sentences.en: Maybe you think you know the story?
sentences.cn: 也许你以为你知道这个故事？

sentences.en: Pushy dad making his son practice every day.
sentences.cn: 逼着儿子天天练球的虎爸。

sentences.en: But actually it was the opposite.
sentences.cn: 其实恰恰相反。

sentences.en: I was the one pushing him.
sentences.cn: 是我追着他要练。

sentences.en: He knew things the other parents didn't.
sentences.cn: 他知道别的家长不知道的东西。

sentences.en: So I wanted him to teach me, to give me an edge.
sentences.cn: 所以我想让他教我，让我比别人多一点优势。

sentences.en: He was particularly obsessed with me developing my awareness and quick feet.
sentences.cn: 他特别执着于练我的观察意识和脚下频率。

sentences.en: He was always getting me to look over my shoulder before receiving the ball.
sentences.cn: 接球前回头的观察，是他一直逼着我养成的习惯。

sentences.en: In winter, when we couldn’t play outside, he took me to the indoor sports hall and we would do drills where he’d play the ball off a bench and it would bounce back to me.
sentences.cn: 冬天没法在室外踢，他就带我去室内体育馆，做那种他把球往长凳上一踢、球反弹回来的练习。

sentences.en: He would come up behind, pressing me from one side and I had to look and adjust before receiving it.
sentences.cn: 他会从背后上来，从一侧逼抢我，我必须先观察、再调整，然后才能接球。

sentences.en: These days, when you see me turn away from a defender, using that touch and quick reading of the game, that’s the sports hall.
sentences.cn: 如今你们看到我背身摆脱防守队员，用那种触球和对比赛的快速阅读——那就是那间体育馆。

sentences.en: That’s my dad.
sentences.cn: 那就是我爸。

sentences.en: I was so focused on being the best at that time.
sentences.cn: 那时候我满脑子只想做到最好。

sentences.en: I knew I was talented but I wasn’t getting ahead of myself.
sentences.cn: 我知道自己有天赋，但我没有飘飘然。

sentences.en: I was just enjoying playing with my friends for my hometown club.
sentences.cn: 我只是在享受和朋友们一起为家乡俱乐部踢球。

sentences.en: Then things started progressing really fast.
sentences.cn: 然后一切都开始加速。

sentences.en: When I was 13, I made my debut for Strømsgodset.
sentences.cn: 十三岁，我完成了斯特罗姆加德的首秀。

sentences.en: When I was 15, I became the youngest player to play for the Norway national team.
sentences.cn: 十五岁，我成了代表挪威国家队出场的最年轻球员。

sentences.en: That’s when things really went crazy.
sentences.cn: 从那时起，一切真的疯狂起来。

sentences.en: I remember coming on for the last 20 minutes of a Euro 2016 qualifier against Bulgaria at the Ullevaal Stadion in Oslo and the whole stadium, more than 20,000 people, going mad.
sentences.cn: 我记得2016年欧洲杯预选赛对保加利亚，在奥斯陆的乌勒瓦尔球场，我第70分钟左右替补登场，全场两万多人瞬间疯狂。

sentences.en: Every time I touched the ball, they cheered.
sentences.cn: 我每次触球，他们都在欢呼。

sentences.en: I can still hear that sound.
sentences.cn: 那个声音我到现在都记得。

sentences.en: The thing is, in Norway, we hadn’t had a “superstar” in such a long time that the fans were a little desperate and when they started hearing this talk about this young guy from Drammen, they just wanted to believe it, even if they didn't actually know if I was any good.
sentences.cn: 事情是这样的：挪威已经太久没有出过“超级巨星”了，球迷们有点饥渴；当他们开始听到关于这个德拉门小伙子的传闻，他们就是想相信，哪怕他们其实并不确定我到底行不行。

sentences.en: It added to this strange hype.
sentences.cn: 这又给那股奇怪的热度添了一把火。

sentences.en: And then the hype just builds more hype, and suddenly you’re linked with Real Madrid.
sentences.cn: 然后热度会生出更多热度，突然之间，你就和皇马联系在一起了。

sentences.en: My dad handled everything with the clubs, and there were a lot.
sentences.cn: 和各家俱乐部的接洽都由我爸打理，找上门的非常多。

sentences.en: We went to Bayern, Dortmund, Man Utd, Liverpool, Madrid, Arsenal too.
sentences.cn: 我们去过拜仁、多特蒙德、曼联、利物浦、皇马，也有阿森纳。

sentences.en: We got flown around in private planes and made to feel special.
sentences.cn: 我们坐私人飞机飞来飞去，处处被当成贵客。

sentences.en: I’m not just saying this…
sentences.cn: 我不是在夸张……

sentences.en: I was actually close to choosing Arsenal.
sentences.cn: 我当时真的很接近选阿森纳。

sentences.en: When we went there, I got to train at London Colney.
sentences.cn: 我们去那里的时候，我在伦敦科尔尼训练基地训练过。

sentences.en: I met Arsène Wenger.
sentences.cn: 我见到了温格。

sentences.en: He took me and Dad out for dinner.
sentences.cn: 他还带我和我爸出去吃了顿饭。

sentences.en: That was cool, but strange too.
sentences.cn: 很酷，但也很奇怪。

sentences.en: It’s Arsène Wenger, you know?
sentences.cn: 那可是温格啊，你懂吗？

sentences.en: He’s this legend I grew up watching on TV, and now I’m sitting across from him eating steak.
sentences.cn: 他是我在电视上看大的传奇，现在我却坐在他对面吃牛排。

sentences.en: I was so nervous I was just sitting there thinking, Is he analysing me right now?
sentences.cn: 我紧张得要命，坐在那儿满脑子想的是：他是不是正在分析我？

sentences.en: Is he going to judge me if I eat the fries?
sentences.cn: 我要是吃了薯条，他会给我打低分吗？

sentences.en: Maybe I should just leave them.
sentences.cn: 要不我还是别碰了。

sentences.en: Hahaha!
sentences.cn: 哈哈哈！

sentences.en: So, why Real Madrid then?
sentences.cn: 那么，为什么最后是皇马？

sentences.en: I talked about it a lot with my dad and the rest of my family.
sentences.cn: 我和我爸、和全家人反复讨论过。

sentences.en: In the end, Madrid is Madrid.
sentences.cn: 说到底，皇马就是皇马。

sentences.en: They were the Champions League holders with the best players in the world.
sentences.cn: 他们是欧冠卫冕冠军，拥有世界上最强的球员。

sentences.en: Back then, I loved Isco — he was so smooth on the ball.
sentences.cn: 那时候我很喜欢伊斯科——他拿球那么丝滑。

sentences.en: Another one of my kind of players!
sentences.cn: 又是一个我喜欢的类型！

sentences.en: But the really key thing about Madrid’s offer was that they had a B team where I could play competitive football immediately.
sentences.cn: 但皇马这份报价里真正关键的东西，是他们的B队——我可以立刻踢上有竞争力的正式比赛。

sentences.en: And the manager of that team?
sentences.cn: 而那支球队的教练是谁？

sentences.en: Zinedine Zidane.
sentences.cn: 齐内丁·齐达内。

sentences.en: It felt like the total package.
sentences.cn: 感觉这就是一份完美套餐。

sentences.en: Before we officially told them, I remember sitting with my dad on the sofa watching a Real Madrid game on TV.
sentences.cn: 在正式答复之前，我记得我和我爸坐在沙发上，看皇马的比赛。

sentences.en: At one point, he turned to me with his phone in his hand like, “Is it time?
sentences.cn: 看着看着，他忽然拿着手机转向我：“是时候了吗？

sentences.en: Should we tell them?”
sentences.cn: 咱们告诉他们吧？”

sentences.en: We’d been speaking about the decision for so long, as it was so hard to turn down all these other amazing clubs.
sentences.cn: 这个决定我们已经讨论了很久，因为拒绝那些同样出色的俱乐部实在太难。

sentences.en: But then we did it.
sentences.cn: 然后我们就发了。

sentences.en: He’d had the draft saved in his phone for like a week or two already.
sentences.cn: 那条信息在他手机里存了大概一两个星期。

sentences.en: This really simple message.
sentences.cn: 非常简单的一句话。

sentences.en: It was something like: “Martin has decided he wants to come, if you still want him.”
sentences.cn: 大意是：“马丁决定要来，如果你们还要他的话。”

sentences.en: I just told him, “Send it.”
sentences.cn: 我只跟他说：“发吧。”

sentences.en: Let’s talk about my presentation day.
sentences.cn: 来说说我的亮相日吧。

sentences.en: I’m actually cringing thinking about it now…
sentences.cn: 现在想起来我都会脚趾抠地……

sentences.en: but I know a lot of people talked about this at the time.
sentences.cn: 但我知道当时很多人都在议论这件事。

sentences.en: I was basically a meme.
sentences.cn: 我基本上成了一个表情包。

sentences.en: So let me clear up what happened.
sentences.cn: 那让我来还原一下当时发生了什么。

sentences.en: They sent a plane to pick us up from Norway in the morning.
sentences.cn: 早上他们派了一架飞机来挪威接我们。

sentences.en: Really early.
sentences.cn: 非常早。

sentences.en: So, I wake up but I’m still half asleep.
sentences.cn: 我醒了，但还半睡半醒。

sentences.en: My hair is all over the place.
sentences.cn: 头发炸得到处都是。

sentences.en: I didn’t have time to shower.
sentences.cn: 来不及洗澡。

sentences.en: I just put on whatever clothes I could grab quickly, throw something smarter into a bag and we take the flight.
sentences.cn: 我随手抓了几件衣服套上，往包里塞了件稍微体面的，就上了飞机。

sentences.en: I figure that once I arrive at the hotel in Madrid I can get changed, take a shower, prepare myself, you know?
sentences.cn: 我心想，等到了马德里的酒店，我可以换衣服、洗个澡、收拾一下自己，对吧？

sentences.en: But then we land, we get off the plane and I realise they are taking us directly to the training ground to do the medical and then the press conference.
sentences.cn: 结果飞机落地，下了舷梯我才发现，他们要直接带我们去训练基地体检，然后开发布会。

sentences.en: No hotel stop.
sentences.cn: 酒店？没有这一站。

sentences.en: And I’m like, Wait, we’re doing this now?
sentences.cn: 我心想：等等，现在就来吗？

sentences.en: Suddenly, I’m sitting next to Madrid legend Emilio Butragueño — who’s wearing a really smart suit, of course — and they are introducing me to the world.
sentences.cn: 突然之间，我坐在皇马传奇布特拉格诺旁边——他当然穿着一身非常精神的西装——他们正在把我介绍给全世界。

sentences.en: I know you’ve seen the pictures.
sentences.cn: 我知道你们看过那些照片。

sentences.en: Me, in this old stripey jumper, not even showered, trying to flatten my hair with my hands.
sentences.cn: 我，穿着那件旧条纹毛衣，澡都没洗，用手拼命压着头发。

sentences.en: This was the biggest day of my life, images going all over the world.
sentences.cn: 那是我人生中最大的一天，照片传遍了全世界。

sentences.en: I’m supposed to be this player that Real Madrid has beaten everyone to sign and I look like a random school kid they just pulled from the stadium tour.
sentences.cn: 我本该是那个皇马力压群雄签下的天才，看上去却像他们刚从球场参观团里随便拉来的中学生。

sentences.en: Butragueño is introducing me and in my head I’m like:
sentences.cn: 布特拉格诺在做介绍，我心里想的是：

sentences.en: God, I wish I’d changed my jumper.
sentences.cn: 天哪，真希望我换了件毛衣。

sentences.en: Someone could’ve told me.
sentences.cn: 怎么没人提醒我一声。

sentences.en: Why didn’t anyone tell me????
sentences.cn: 为什么没有任何人告诉我？？？

sentences.en: Hahaha!
sentences.cn: 哈哈哈！

sentences.en: The other thing I’m thinking about at that moment, sitting there in front of all these people, is my Confirmation.
sentences.cn: 那一刻，坐在这么多人面前，我脑子里想的另一件事，是我的坚振礼。

sentences.en: If you don’t know, it’s a common ceremony for kids in Norway to go through where you celebrate becoming an adult.
sentences.cn: 如果你不了解，这是挪威孩子都会经历的一种成人仪式。

sentences.en: I did mine when I was 15.
sentences.cn: 我十五岁时办的。

sentences.en: It’s just for family and close friends and it’s normal that at the end of the event, the kid gets up to do a short speech to thank everyone for coming.
sentences.cn: 只有家人和好友参加，按惯例仪式的最后，过礼的孩子要站起来做个简短致辞，感谢大家的到来。

sentences.en: Except at mine, I froze.
sentences.cn: 可轮到我的时候，我僵住了。

sentences.en: I was too shy to speak in front of my family — the people I’m most comfortable with!
sentences.cn: 在最让我放松的人——我的家人——面前，我居然紧张得说不出话！

sentences.en: I was confident on the football pitch, but speaking in front of people?
sentences.cn: 在球场上我信心十足，可要当众讲话？

sentences.en: No way.
sentences.cn: 没门。

sentences.en: One year later, I’m front and centre at a Real Madrid press conference.
sentences.cn: 一年之后，我就坐在了皇马发布会的正中央。

sentences.en: In this stripey jumper.
sentences.cn: 穿着那件条纹毛衣。

sentences.en: Haha can you imagine??
sentences.cn: 哈哈你能想象吗？？

sentences.en: I was so out of my comfort zone.
sentences.cn: 我完全不在自己的舒适区。

sentences.en: You can see the fear in my face.
sentences.cn: 你能从我脸上看到恐惧。

sentences.en: When it’s my turn to speak, I have these big headphones on and I’m practically whispering in Norwegian like, “Uh yeah…
sentences.cn: 轮到我发言时，我戴着巨大的同传耳机，用挪威语小声嘀咕：“呃，好的……

sentences.en: It’s a great pleasure.
sentences.cn: 我很荣幸。

sentences.en: Ummm, I’m very proud.…”
sentences.cn: 嗯……我非常骄傲……”

sentences.en: But in a weird way, I think that moment actually helped a lot of people’s perceptions of me.
sentences.cn: 但说来奇怪，我觉得那个瞬间反而改变了很多人对我的看法。

sentences.en: As soon as you get famous, people expect you to be a certain way.
sentences.cn: 人一出名，别人就会期待你按某种方式活着。
