sentences.en: Like you’re this superhero, who can do anything.
sentences.cn: 好像你是个无所不能的超级英雄。

sentences.en: You can play football, so you also must be able to speak well, be confident, give everything of yourself at all times.
sentences.cn: 你会踢球，所以你也必须会讲话、必须自信、必须随时随地掏出全部的自己。

sentences.en: But that’s not realistic.
sentences.cn: 可这不现实。

sentences.en: I think that press conference helped people connect to what I was going through.
sentences.cn: 我觉得那场发布会让人们理解了我当时的处境。

sentences.en: I was just this shy little kid.
sentences.cn: 我只是一个害羞的小孩。

sentences.en: I mean, have you met a 16-year-old recently?
sentences.cn: 这么说吧，你最近见过十六岁的孩子吗？

sentences.en: They felt for me and saw how normal I was.
sentences.cn: 他们心疼我，也看到了我有多普通。

sentences.en: A few days after the presentation, I went into training for the first time and, honestly, that was just surreal.
sentences.cn: 亮相几天后，我第一次去一线队训练，说实话，那感觉超现实。

sentences.en: I’m not old enough to drive, so my dad actually has to bring me in to play with Isco and Ronaldo and Ramos and Modric and Bale and Benzema, like he’s dropping me off at school.
sentences.cn: 我还没到开车的年纪，得由我爸送我去和伊斯科、C罗、拉莫斯、莫德里奇、贝尔、本泽马一起训练，就像送我上学一样。

sentences.en: All I’m thinking is about how these guys will treat me when I walk into their dressing room.
sentences.cn: 我满脑子想的都是：走进他们的更衣室时，这些大人物会怎么对我。

sentences.en: This little kid who didn’t speak any Spanish.
sentences.cn: 一个西班牙语都不会说的小屁孩。

sentences.en: But they were all very kind, and the ones who spoke English — Kroos, Modric, Ronaldo — took extra care of me in the beginning.
sentences.cn: 但他们都非常友善，会说英语的那几个——克罗斯、莫德里奇、C罗——一开始还格外照顾我。

sentences.en: They gave me advice and helped me a lot.
sentences.cn: 他们给我建议，帮了我很多。

sentences.en: But honestly I don’t think any of them were particularly worried about a 16-year-old from Norway taking their place in the team.
sentences.cn: 不过说实话，我想他们谁也没怎么担心过一个来自挪威的十六岁小孩会抢走他们的位置。

sentences.en: We made this plan with the club that I would train every day with the first team but get regular game time with the B team.
sentences.cn: 我们和俱乐部定了一个计划：我每天跟一线队训练，但定期跟B队打比赛。

sentences.en: It seemed like a smart plan at the time, but it worked out that I ended up not finding my place with either group.
sentences.cn: 当时看着很聪明，结果却是我两边都没找到归属。

sentences.en: With the B team, I wasn’t with them regularly so I didn’t find that connection.
sentences.cn: 在B队，我不常在，融不进那个集体。

sentences.en: In the first team, I was just some kid who came to train.
sentences.cn: 在一线队，我只是个来训练的小孩。

sentences.en: I wasn’t involved in matches.
sentences.cn: 比赛没有我的份。

sentences.en: I felt a bit like an outsider.
sentences.cn: 我有点像个局外人。

sentences.en: I was stuck in between.
sentences.cn: 我卡在中间。

sentences.en: I stopped playing with the spark that was typical of my game.
sentences.cn: 我踢球失去了那种标志性的火花。

sentences.en: I went a bit too safe for a time.
sentences.cn: 有段时间我踢得太过保守。

sentences.en: I was worrying more about not making mistakes than actually playing my game.
sentences.cn: 我更怕犯错，而不是去做自己真正擅长的事。

sentences.en: And my game was always about making a difference.
sentences.cn: 而我的足球，从来都是关于改变比赛的。

sentences.en: Playing the difficult pass.
sentences.cn: 传出那些刁钻的球。

sentences.en: I can understand why it happened now.
sentences.cn: 现在我理解这一切是怎么发生的了。

sentences.en: I was still a little kid, but I’ve learned that you have to be ruthless.
sentences.cn: 那时我还是个小孩，但我后来懂得：你必须狠。

sentences.en: You have to not give a f***.
sentences.cn: 你必须豁出去，谁的脸色都不看。

sentences.en: You have to show the real you on the pitch.
sentences.cn: 你必须把真实的自己亮在球场上。

sentences.en: After a couple of years, I just wasn’t progressing.
sentences.cn: 几年过去，我没有进步。

sentences.en: The press came after me for not immediately living up to the hype.
sentences.cn: 媒体开始围攻我，因为我没有立刻兑现那些吹捧。

sentences.en: I was an easy target.
sentences.cn: 我是个好靶子。

sentences.en: If you really know me, you know I smile a lot, but I think from the outside sometimes my face looks more grumpy than I actually am!
sentences.cn: 如果你真的了解我，你知道我其实很爱笑，但我猜从外面看，我的脸有时显得比实际更臭！

sentences.en: It made it easier for them to write about how I was struggling to adapt.
sentences.cn: 这让他们写“我难以适应”更容易了。

sentences.en: I remember reading a headline like: “NOW IT’S MAKE OR BREAK TIME FOR MARTIN ØDEGAARD”
sentences.cn: 我记得读过一个大标题：“马丁·厄德高，现在是成是败的关键时刻”

sentences.en: And I’m like, make or break?
sentences.cn: 我心想：成或败？

sentences.en: I’m 18 years old!
sentences.cn: 我才十八岁！

sentences.en: Maybe if I’d been Spanish, I might have been given a bit more time to grow.
sentences.cn: 如果我是个西班牙球员，也许人们会多给我一些成长的时间。

sentences.en: Honestly, I don’t know.
sentences.cn: 说实话，我不知道。

sentences.en: In the end, it’s just the nature of the hype machine.
sentences.cn: 说到底，这就是热度机器的天性。

sentences.en: There is no in-between in modern football.
sentences.cn: 现代足球里没有中间地带。

sentences.en: You’re either the best signing in history, or you’re sh**.
sentences.cn: 你要么是史上最佳签约，要么就是垃圾。

sentences.en: Listen, I want to make it clear that I am not complaining about my time at Real Madrid.
sentences.cn: 听着，我想说清楚：我不是在抱怨皇马时光。

sentences.en: Not at all.
sentences.cn: 完全没有。

sentences.en: Going to Madrid was a good thing for me.
sentences.cn: 去马德里对我来说是好事。

sentences.en: I learned so much about what it takes to reach the top.
sentences.cn: 关于登顶需要付出什么，我学到了太多。

sentences.en: I watched, trained and learned from the best players in the world, my idols.
sentences.cn: 我观察着、训练着，向世界上最强的球员、我的偶像们学习。

sentences.en: I played at the Bernabéu.
sentences.cn: 我在伯纳乌踢过球。

sentences.en: I learned to be tough and to face challenges.
sentences.cn: 我学会了坚强，学会了直面挑战。

sentences.en: It’s part of who I am now.
sentences.cn: 这已经是我的一部分。

sentences.en: It’s the reason I’m where I am today.
sentences.cn: 正因如此，我才有今天。

sentences.en: But when things got tough, I never lost sight of the bigger picture.
sentences.cn: 但当日子变得艰难时，我从未丢掉对大局的判断。

sentences.en: In my head I was always like, How can I change?
sentences.cn: 我心里始终想的是：我怎么改变？

sentences.en: How can I get better?
sentences.cn: 我怎么变强？

sentences.en: Because in the end, I will never be the guy who is happy to just train at the biggest club and maybe get a few minutes here and there.
sentences.cn: 因为说到底，我永远不会做那种“在最大的俱乐部训练训练、偶尔捞几分钟上场就很满足”的人。

sentences.en: I was always thinking about what I needed to do to be the best version of me I could be.
sentences.cn: 我一直在想，要怎样做才能成为最好的自己。

sentences.en: That’s why I needed to move on.
sentences.cn: 这就是我必须继续前进的原因。

sentences.en: Back when I was coming up in Norway, it seemed like I had all the options in the world.
sentences.cn: 当年在挪威蹿红的时候，我似乎手握全世界的选项。

sentences.en: Only a couple of years later, I had to come to terms with the fact that clubs weren’t lining up for me anymore.
sentences.cn: 仅仅几年之后，我就不得不接受：俱乐部们已经不再排着队要我了。

sentences.en: If you’re playing Career Mode and you go from Real Madrid to Heerenveen, maybe you think something has gone wrong.
sentences.cn: 如果你在生涯模式里从皇马转会去海伦芬，也许你会觉得哪里出问题了。

sentences.en: No offence to the Dutch league!
sentences.cn: 没有冒犯荷甲的意思！

sentences.en: But honestly, for me, it was a fantastic experience.
sentences.cn: 但说实话，对我而言，那是一段绝佳的经历。

sentences.en: I got to play regularly at first-team level, which was exactly what I needed.
sentences.cn: 我获得了一线队的稳定出场，这正是我需要的。

sentences.en: I owe a lot to my loans at Heerenveen, where I grew as a person, and Vitesse, where I grew as a player.
sentences.cn: 我很感激在海伦芬和维特斯的租借——在海伦芬我作为一个人成长了，在维特斯我作为一名球员成长了。

sentences.en: At Heerenveen, I got my driving licence (I didn’t need my dad taking me to training anymore), I learned to be by myself and to take responsibility.
sentences.cn: 在海伦芬，我考下了驾照（再也不用我爸送我去训练了），学会了独立生活、自己扛责任。

sentences.en: Then at Vitesse, I met the manager Leonid Slutsky.
sentences.cn: 然后到了维特斯，我遇到了主教练莱昂尼德·斯卢茨基。

sentences.en: He was amazing.
sentences.cn: 他非常出色。

sentences.en: He believed in my ability without asking me to be magical every time.
sentences.cn: 他相信我的能力，却从不要求我每次都变魔术。

sentences.en: He improved my decision making and teamwork.
sentences.cn: 他提升了我的决策和团队配合。

sentences.en: Soon I was finding the difficult passes again.
sentences.cn: 很快，我又开始传出那些刁钻的球了。

sentences.en: After two and a half seasons on loan in the Netherlands, I was ready to come back to La Liga and settle down at Real Sociedad for at least two seasons.
sentences.cn: 在荷兰租借的两个半赛季之后，我已经准备好回到西甲，在皇家社会安顿下来，至少踢两个赛季。

sentences.en: In the end, it didn’t work out that way.
sentences.cn: 最终，事情没有按那个剧本走。

sentences.en: It’s an amazing club in a beautiful part of the world, with fans that are so connected to their team.
sentences.cn: 那是一家了不起的俱乐部，坐落在世界上一片美丽的角落，球迷和球队血肉相连。

sentences.en: In a way, the Basque culture is more like Norway.
sentences.cn: 某种意义上，巴斯克文化更像挪威。

sentences.en: People are more reserved on the outside but once they take you into their hearts, they are so caring and protective.
sentences.cn: 人们外表比较内敛，可一旦你走进他们心里，他们无比体贴、无比护短。

sentences.en: You become one of their own.
sentences.cn: 你会成为“他们自己人”。

sentences.en: I loved that.
sentences.cn: 我爱极了这一点。

sentences.en: I was playing well and I was really happy there, but after a year when Madrid called I thought, I have to take this chance now.
sentences.cn: 我踢得很好，在那里非常开心，但一年后皇马来电话时，我心想：这个机会我现在必须抓住。

sentences.en: This is the dream I’ve been following since I was 16.
sentences.cn: 这是我从十六岁起就追随的梦想。

sentences.en: I had a good connection with Zidane from when he coached the B team and he took good care of me, so I wanted to believe it would work out this time.
sentences.cn: 我和齐达内在他带B队时就关系很好，他一直很照顾我，所以我愿意相信这一次会成。

sentences.en: But then I got COVID.
sentences.cn: 但我得了新冠。

sentences.en: I started the first two games of that season in 2020-21, but I wasn’t fully recovered.
sentences.cn: 2020-21赛季的前两场我都是首发，但我没有完全恢复。

sentences.en: I didn’t perform at my best and after that, I didn’t get many more chances.
sentences.cn: 我没能拿出最好的状态，之后机会就变得寥寥。

sentences.en: Almost nothing.
sentences.cn: 几乎为零。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, I’m watching Real Sociedad on TV thinking, I could’ve still been there.
sentences.cn: 与此同时，我在电视上看皇家社会的比赛，心想：我本来还可以留在那儿的。

sentences.en: I was thinking about this a lot.
sentences.cn: 这个问题我想了很久。

sentences.en: I spoke to my agent ahead of the January transfer window, “Look, we need to do something…
sentences.cn: 一月转会窗之前我跟经纪人说：“听着，我们得做点什么……

sentences.en: I didn’t come back to just be there.
sentences.cn: 我回来不是为了坐着的。

sentences.en: I came back here to play.
sentences.cn: 我回来是为了上场。

sentences.en: I need to play and keep improving.”
sentences.cn: 我需要比赛，需要持续进步。”

sentences.en: He tried to calm me down, telling me we’d just cancelled one contract to come back to Madrid.
sentences.cn: 他想让我冷静，说我们刚毁约了一次才回的马德里。

sentences.en: I’d always said I wanted stability and now five months later I wanted to move again?
sentences.cn: 我一直说要稳定，结果五个月后又要走？

sentences.en: But I had made up my mind.
sentences.cn: 但我已经拿定了主意。

sentences.en: I can only thank Madrid for investing in a 16-year-old kid.
sentences.cn: 对于皇马在一个十六岁孩子身上的投入，我只有感激。

sentences.en: Everybody had good intentions and I don’t blame anyone, but I needed to find a place where I could settle.
sentences.cn: 每个人都出于好意，我不怪任何人，但我需要找到一个能扎根的地方。

sentences.en: I needed to find an actual home.
sentences.cn: 我需要一个真正的家。

sentences.en: I found it in North London.
sentences.cn: 我在北伦敦找到了它。

sentences.en: Career Mode.
sentences.cn: 生涯模式。

sentences.en: This little memory in the back of my mind just flashed up the second my agent mentioned that Arsenal were interested.
sentences.cn: 经纪人一提到阿森纳有意，我脑海深处的那段小记忆就闪了出来。

sentences.en: It just felt right.
sentences.cn: 就是觉得对了。

sentences.en: I spoke to Mikel Arteta on a Zoom call and he told me all about the project.
sentences.cn: 我和米克尔·阿尔特塔视频通话，他给我讲了整个计划。

sentences.en: At the time, Arsenal were not doing well.
sentences.cn: 那时阿森纳处境不好。

sentences.en: They were way down like 15th in the table, but that meeting…
sentences.cn: 联赛排名掉到了第十五左右，但那次谈话……

sentences.en: Honestly, I challenge anyone to come away from a meeting with Arteta and not believe everything he tells you.
sentences.cn: 说实话，我敢向任何人挑战：跟阿尔特塔谈完，你不可能不信他说的一切。

sentences.en: He is next level.
sentences.cn: 他是另一个级别的。

sentences.en: It's hard to explain.
sentences.cn: 很难解释。

sentences.en: He’s passionate, he’s intense and sometimes, yeah, he’s a bit crazy…
sentences.cn: 他有激情、有强度，有时候，嗯，是有点疯……

sentences.en: but when he speaks, you understand that whatever he says will happen, will happen.
sentences.cn: 但当他开口，你会明白：他说会发生的事，就会发生。

sentences.en: He told me his plan, everything he was building towards.
sentences.cn: 他跟我讲了计划，讲了他正在打造的一切。

sentences.en: He knew exactly what needed to change at the club.
sentences.cn: 他很清楚俱乐部哪里需要改变。

sentences.en: He told me all about these amazing young players in the squad — Saka, Martinelli, Smith Rowe, etc., etc. He told me how he wanted me to fit in and how I was going to improve.
sentences.cn: 他给我讲了队里那些出色的年轻人——萨卡、马丁内利、史密斯·罗，等等等等。他讲了想让我怎样融入，我会怎样进步。

sentences.en: I got this strong feeling that he was onto something really special.
sentences.cn: 我有一种强烈的预感：他正在成就一番真正特别的事业。

sentences.en: Not that I needed any more convincing but I also got so many messages from Arsenal fans on Instagram telling me to sign.
sentences.cn: 倒不需要更多说服，Instagram 上还有成千上万的阿森纳球迷给我发消息催我签约。

sentences.en: Not just me, my whole family, friends and everyone I follow!
sentences.cn: 不只是我，我全家人、朋友们、我关注的所有人都在收！

sentences.en: It’s such an amazing, active fan base.
sentences.cn: 这球迷群体真是又热情又活跃。

sentences.en: Random people I know would show me how the comments on their posts were full of stuff like “Tell Martin to sign for Arsenal.”
sentences.cn: 我认识的一些普通人会给我看，他们帖子底下的评论全都是“让马丁签阿森纳”。

sentences.en: That was just…
sentences.cn: 那感觉真是……

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.cn: 哇。

sentences.en: I have to say, the fans have been amazing since I’ve been here.
sentences.cn: 我必须说，自从我来到这里，球迷一直太棒了。

sentences.en: Maybe some people think that doesn't matter to us as players, but it matters.
sentences.cn: 也许有人觉得这对我们球员不重要，但它重要。

sentences.en: At the Emirates, every time you make a tackle to knock the ball out for a throw-in, the whole stadium cheers like you've scored a goal.
sentences.cn: 在酋长球场，哪怕你只是一次把球铲出边线的防守，全场都会像你进球一样欢呼。

sentences.en: They give you this confidence that you can do anything.
sentences.cn: 他们给你一种“你什么都能做到”的自信。

sentences.en: At the end of my first season here in 2020-21, when we finished eighth, it seemed like no one at the club lost faith in what we were doing.
sentences.cn: 我在这里的第一个赛季，2020-21赛季末我们排第八，俱乐部里似乎没有人对我们正在做的事失去信心。

sentences.en: Everyone believed in us.
sentences.cn: 所有人都相信我们。

sentences.en: It was all part of the plan.
sentences.cn: 这都是计划的一部分。

sentences.en: Even last season when things got really tough.
sentences.cn: 哪怕上赛季那么艰难的时候也一样。

sentences.en: Obviously, we took it hard losing out on Champions League qualification when it was in our hands like that, but we learned from that experience.
sentences.cn: 显然，眼看着欧冠资格攥在手里却最终错失，我们都很痛苦，但我们从那段经历里学到了东西。

sentences.en: We came back closer, stronger, hungrier.
sentences.cn: 我们以更团结、更强壮、更饥饿的姿态回归。

sentences.en: We’re in the title race now, but there’s a long way to go and, trust me, no one is thinking about May yet.
sentences.cn: 现在我们在争冠行列，但路还很长，相信我，还没有人开始想五月的事。

sentences.en: It’s a cliché but we are taking it game by game, training session by training session.
sentences.cn: 话虽老套，我们就是一场一场地踢，一练一练地练。

sentences.en: One piece at a time.
sentences.cn: 一块砖一块砖地砌。

sentences.en: I will say this, though, if there’s anyone left who still doesn’t fully believe in this team, take it from me: there are no limits on what we can achieve.
sentences.cn: 不过我要说：如果还有人没有完全相信这支球队，听我一句——我们能达到的高度没有上限。

sentences.en: No one can tell me otherwise.
sentences.cn: 谁说什么我都不能同意。

sentences.en: I’m so proud to be captain of this club and I feel like I’m going to be here a long time.
sentences.cn: 能担任这家俱乐部的队长，我无比自豪，而且我感觉自己会在这里待很久。

sentences.en: After the win over West Ham on Boxing Day, I got the chance to speak to Wenger — it was the first time he’d been back to the Emirates since 2018, and the first time I’d seen him since that steak and fries all those years ago.
sentences.cn: 节礼日赢下西汉姆之后，我有机会和温格聊了聊——那是2018年以来他第一次回到酋长球场，也是自当年那顿牛排薯条之后，我第一次见他。

sentences.en: We had a good chat and he mentioned that he’d kept a close eye on my career even after I chose Madrid.
sentences.cn: 我们聊得很愉快。他说即使在我选择皇马之后，他也一直关注着我的职业生涯。

sentences.en: He was honest and said that at one point he was actually worried about the way things were going for me, but now he’s so happy to see me doing well in the right environment.
sentences.cn: 他很坦诚，说有一阵子他真的为我的处境担心过，但现在看到我在对的环境里过得很好，他非常高兴。

sentences.en: He’d recognised something.
sentences.cn: 他看出了某种东西。

sentences.en: Ever since I left Norway, it’s like everything has felt sort of temporary.
sentences.cn: 离开挪威之后，一切都像是临时性的。

sentences.en: I haven’t had that stability, that real deep connection, until now, and that’s so important.
sentences.cn: 我始终没有那种稳定感、那种真正深层的联结，直到现在——而这太重要了。

sentences.en: Whenever I lead the team out at the Emirates, I have this moment to myself.
sentences.cn: 每当我在酋长球场率队出场，我都有一个属于自己的瞬间。

sentences.en: I want to really feel that atmosphere, that electricity from the fans.
sentences.cn: 我想真正去感受那种氛围，球迷带来的那种电流。

sentences.en: I always listen as they play North London Forever over the speakers and I start singing along under my breath.
sentences.cn: 当扬声器里响起 North London Forever，我总会跟着轻声哼唱。

sentences.en: I get goosebumps every time.
sentences.cn: 每次都起鸡皮疙瘩。

sentences.en: I close my eyes, and I think about myself as a kid out on the artificial pitch in Drammen.
sentences.cn: 我闭上眼睛，想起小时候那个在德拉门人工球场上的自己。

sentences.en: If you’d have shown that kid a snapshot of this moment and told him this was in his future?
sentences.cn: 如果你把此刻的画面拿给那个孩子看，告诉他这会是他未来的一部分？

sentences.en: He would have died for this.
sentences.cn: 为了这个，他什么都愿意。

sentences.en: It’s been a hell of a long road, but I’m living my dream.
sentences.cn: 这是一条长得要命的路，但我正活在自己的梦里。

sentences.en: I’m home.
sentences.cn: 我到家了。

sentences.en: And the best is yet to come.
sentences.cn: 而最好的，还在后面。
